> **Phase 90 (2026-11-22, branch `feat/encoder-ext-90-feasibility`) — encoder extension FEASIBILITY + DESIGN: measured, designed, priced; nothing built.** The owner commissioned the encoder extension on 2026-11-22 ("lanjut ekstensi") — Phase 88's menu option (iii), the only route to a full M1 close. This phase is measurement + design only: seven z3-gated probe tests in the verifier's test module (commit `ca3d289`; one, the ~36 s symbolic STEP instrument, `#[ignore]`d), no production code changed, no spec amended, the examples file untouched. The full record is the standalone design document [`ENCODER_EXTENSION_DESIGN.md`](ENCODER_EXTENSION_DESIGN.md); this note is its summary. **The boundary is wider than the Phase 88 framing (ten walls, W1–W10 in the design doc):** behind the missing While arm sit constructor-pattern Match (`sym_match` skips Constructor arms wholesale), `UnaryOp::Clone`, the missing (List, List) arm in `sym_ite`, and Append's missing length-only and (Str, CharStr) forms — each measured in situ killing the faithful bodies; and the denotation gap is wider than (β) states — **`next_char` has no resolver denotation either** (`record_completion_body`, engine.rs:4810, is seed-only and absent from the `callee_body` chain, engine.rs:6416), so a While arm alone creates no denotations. **Part 1 (While), measured:** a probe statement-mode evaluator with solver-guided unrolling decides every battery point exactly — skip 12/12 at minimal fuel = trip count (outputs mirror-exact, row (a) Proven 12/12 including the two EOF points Phase 87 left Unknown), STEP 10/10 and LOOP 8/8 at the predicted fuels `max(skip, ident+1)` / `max(outer, inner)` — while symbolic verdicts are **Unknown at every fuel** (skip fuels 1/2/4 under current rows, (a), and (a)+(c) in both encodings; STEP row 1 Unknown at fuels 1/2), because exhaustion is always reachable: **unrolling can never Verify these loops; it refutes and it decides points.** Its decisive refutation: tokenize_one's row 2 **Refuted** at fuels 1/2 symbolically and at the point — the faithful body errs at `" 5"` and R2-α's license reads the pre-skip char, so **no encoder strength can Verify the faithful body against the standing rows**; the β-skip license (Err licensed by the char at the *skipped* position), unstatable in Phase 83 for want of a skip denotation, is measured statable-and-encodable the moment skip denotes (admits the faithful Err, refutes a fabricated one). Costs measured: naive merging unrolling grows ~×8 per iteration (1/3/15/118/896 ms at fuels 0–4 on a one-trip point) against flat 5 ms guided on points; guided decisions inside nested symbolic denotations reach the 5 s solver cap; term equality by Debug string cost 96 s where node identity is O(1). **Loop invariants are the only route to symbolic Verified** — the IR While node already carries an unpopulated, unread `invariant: Option<String>` field (engine.rs:202) — and the one risky VC, skip's ∀-between invariant consecution, **discharges in 5–6 ms** (Part 2). **Part 2 (Forall), measured:** the (c) row through `z3::ast::forall_const` is **Proven 12/12** at the skip battery points (0–25 ms) with both overshoot outputs **Refuted**; a bounded expansion is Proven 12/12 at ~0 ms; identity/partial outputs are admitted by (c) alone — the exact pin is (a)+(c) jointly, as Phase 87 predicted. Quantifiers are not hopeless; they were never the hard part. **Recommended strategy (design doc §2.7/§3.3):** hybrid — statement-mode encoder with exhaustion-disciplined unrolling (refutation/point path) + loop invariants (the Verified path) + `forall_const` (bounded expansion as fallback) + keyed resolver denotations + the interpreter statement subset (without which the template's tpr stays 0.000 and nothing can crown). **Build plan: Phases 91–97** — 91 small encoder arms (S), 92 resolver denotations (M), 93 statement-mode encoder + unrolling (L), 94 Forall encoding (S–M), 95 interpreter subset (M), 96 loop invariants + the ratifications (L), 97 crowning campaign + gate re-run #3 (M). **Three owner-ratification points the plan depends on:** **R1** skip spec strengthening (a)+(c) (without it α stays open by spec — the identity body is Verified under the current rows); **R2** tokenize_one row 2 round 3, the R2-β-skip form (without it (β) cannot close in full — the faithful body is refuted, measured); **R3** F2, Int→decimal conversion for the Err message text (without it "exact" caps at 9/10 + 7/8 on message text, or the gate text must exclude it). Honest remainder (design doc §5): crowning stays a search outcome (the G5 precedent), the tokenize loops' frame+progress invariants are argued but not yet discharged, and the W8 literal-tag boundaries (unwrap at a literal Err; literal-OOB index) remain as point-judging limits. **Suites: 497/0/30 default, 497/0/30 bootstrap-codegen, 405/0/22 no-Z3** (baselines 491/491/405; delta = +6 live probes, +1 ignored, zero in the no-Z3 configuration by construction). No push, no merge; the branch awaits the owner's ratifications and the Phase 91 go-ahead.

> **Phase 91 (2026-11-22, branch `feat/encoder-ext-91-small-arms`) — encoder small arms BUILT: W2/W3/W4/W5 land in `sym_match` / `sym_unary_ir` / `sym_ite` / `sym_binop`, each mirrored in `encodable.rs` lockstep.** The first build phase of the ENCODER_EXTENSION_DESIGN.md plan, promoted from the Phase 90 probes that measured each boundary in situ (the seven probes of commit `ca3d289` stand untouched as the measurement record — none was subsumed; the production tests below are new). **W2 — constructor-pattern Match:** `sym_match` no longer skips Constructor arms wholesale. `Some`/`None` over an Option scrutinee and `Ok`/`Err` over a Result scrutinee encode against the Phase 76 tag+payload model: the arm's condition is the tag side it discriminates (a literal opposing tag makes the arm dead, exactly like a Never literal; a literal matching tag makes it unconditional), Variable/Wildcard sub-patterns bind the payload slot, and a match with no unconditional arm is encodable exactly when live arms jointly cover both tag sides — the folded value's fallback is then unreachable by construction. Declines, kept: nested sub-patterns, the other tagged form's constructors, payload patterns against slots that carry none, guard patterns. **W3 — Clone:** the identity in `sym_unary_ir` (a value copy over immutable Sym terms is the value). **W4 — `sym_ite` (List, List):** elementwise merge of two concrete lists; unequal lengths decline — no merged length exists to name. **W5 — Append:** a length-only arm (`ListLen` n → n+1, exact whatever the unmodelled element is) and the (Str, CharStr) concat arm — the lexeme shape, with the bridge's out-of-bounds totalization riding along (an out-of-bounds indexed char is the empty string and appends nothing). The (Str, Char-scalar) form is deliberately NOT armed: it stays unencodable rather than guessing a conversion the design did not price. **Evidence:** seven new z3-gated tests (`phase91_*`), written failing-first — all six flip tests stood at Inconclusive before the arms landed. Option and Result constructor matches Verify with the payload bind load-bearing (the identity over Option through a match Verifies; a fabricated payload Refutes); swapped arms and a dropped Ok payload **Refute**; the headline shape — a Match over `peek(state)` itself, rebuilding the inlined free-tag Option arm by arm — **Verifies** against peek's rows, and its arm-swapped twin Refutes; Clone Verifies as the identity (including over peek's whole result) and Refutes over a different value; the (List, List) merge Verifies through an Index and Refutes with branches exchanged; both Append arms Verify (the ListLen body against `output == len(xs)+1`; the CharStr body against the guarded length row whose `len(s)==0` disjunct states the bridge totalization exactly) while no-append and double-append bodies Refute; every decline named above stays Inconclusive. The `encodable.rs` cross-check corpus gains nine Phase 91 corner bodies; the pure mirror agrees with the symbolic predicate on all of them. **Regression — the frozen standings do not move:** cross-validation ×3 runs identical to the Phase 86 freeze as amended by Phase 87 (classifiers Verified + 774/774 each; peek/next_char Verified + 39/39; skip_whitespace modal 4/12 with the freeze's own recorded E0689 draw; tokenize template agreement 9/10 + 7/8, sole deviation the Err message text); the Codegen probe holds **129/129 winners Verified in all 3 runs**; `morphic check examples/functional_tokenizer.morph` valid; production changes confined to `src/verify/` (verifier.rs + encodable.rs), the examples file untouched, no spec amended. **Suites: 504/0/30 default, 504/0/30 bootstrap-codegen, 405/0/22 no-Z3** (baselines 497/497/405; the delta is exactly the +7 new tests, all Z3-gated, zero in the no-Z3 configuration by construction). **One design-doc correction, recorded:** ENCODER_EXTENSION_DESIGN.md §1 (W3) says "the interpreter evaluates Clone fine" — the in-process interpreter does not (eval.rs groups Clone with Head/Tail/Init/Last/Reverse as not-evaluable); the executed 39/39 the sentence cites is the compiled runner's, where Clone renders as a copy. The arm's semantics is unaffected (a copy is the value under either reading), but the interpreter half of that sentence belongs to the Phase 95 subset work, with the rest of W9. Next: Phase 92 (resolver denotations, M).
> **Phase 92 (2026-11-22, branch `feat/encoder-ext-92-denotations`) — resolver denotations BUILT (design doc §2.6): the three specs that denoted nowhere now denote, and no standing verdict moves.** Three entries appended at the END of the `SpecIndex::callee_body` chain (the Phase 81 append discipline — each fires only where every predecessor declines, and every earlier denotation is pinned byte-identical to its builder's direct output): **(1) `record_completion_body` dual-registered** — the Phase 81 seed builder becomes next_char's resolver meaning, the same construction in both roles; **(2) a keyed skip denotation** (`skip_denotation_body`) returning the Phase 85 hand While body (Alloc cur; While over a peek Match; Assign cur = next_char(cur); Return cur), parameterized by the spec's own parameter name and the shape's declared names — for this module, byte-identical to the hand transcription; **(3) a keyed step denotation** (`tokenize_step_denotation_body`) returning the template's STEP body (the construction extracted verbatim into `tokenize_step_body`, shared with the Phase 85 seed — the moved segment is byte-identical, and the Phase 85 template measurement re-passes). **Keying is structural only, the phase brief's stricter ruling over the design doc's looser "keyed the same way":** the tokenizer field fingerprint (`tokenize_shape`: source/pos/line/col/tokens + the token record's kind/lexeme/line/col, names and types), the declared signature (state→state for skip; the step return Result<R, String> for tokenize_one), and the callees each body actually calls, present by name with the tokenizer's signatures (names load-bearing only where IR calls are by name — the template precedent). **The rows are never consulted** — for skip that is the honesty constraint itself (its rows admit the identity; a row-derived "denotation" would be a lie), and for the step it is a deliberate difference from the seed builder, whose rows-shape gate is a candidate-admission standard, not a meaning: a future row amendment (R2, Phase 96) cannot make the step's meaning vanish from under tokenize_all's judging. The fingerprint is a subset key, pinned as designed behavior (the template's own discipline — its state_record carries unrecognized fields): re-typing or renaming a load-bearing field declines both builders, while an extra field is carried and both still denote. **next_char, measured:** before — `callee_body` None, no body calling next_char Z3-evaluable at all (design finding 2); after — the denotation **self-verifies** against next_char's own rows with peek composed inside its guard (the Phase 81 precedent one level deeper), total `verify_one` wall time **4 ms** — the nested-denotation solver cost the design doc flagged (guided decisions touching the 5 s cap inside the merging-mode STEP instrument) does not materialize on this expression-mode composition; a bare `next_char(state)` call-body Verifies through the denotation, and `next_char(next_char(state))` **Refutes** (the denotation is semantically load-bearing, not a rubber stamp). **Compositions, before → after:** skip denoted inside a judging context — Some, but symbolic judging through it stays **Inconclusive** (the While arm is Phase 93's, pinned as a dependency, not a failure: `body_is_encodable_with` agrees false, and the STEP denotation as a candidate for tokenize_one likewise stays Inconclusive — a denotation manufactures no verdicts); the Phase 90 BMC discipline, re-run with the denotation map supplied **entirely by production `callee_body`**, reproduces Phase 90's verdicts point for point — skip **12/12** at fuel = trip count, outputs mirror-exact, current rows Proven and strengthening row (a) **Proven at all 12 points**; STEP **10/10** at the predicted fuels (rows Proven at Ok points; row 1 Unknown at Err points — the W8 literal-Err boundary); LOOP **8/8** over the production step denotation (token lists exact; the row Proven at Ok points); and at the diagnostic point the faithful body still errs at `" 5"` and standing row 2 still **Refutes** it, now through production resolver meanings end to end — the residue is R2's ratification (Phase 96), not an encoder gap. `tokenize_all` denotes nothing (its LOOP body is the candidate under judgment, not a meaning) — pinned. **Teeth:** the shape-mutation battery above (re-typed field, renamed field, Bool-returning skip, missing is_whitespace — the skip denotation declines while the step's stands, their dependency sets being exactly their bodies' call sets — missing peek, both decline); the identity/partial-skip teeth under rows (a)/(b) re-run inside the re-pinned Phase 87 measurement, unmoved. **Two pre-existing assertions re-pinned**, each with its reason recorded in place: the Phase 84 and Phase 87 tests asserted `callee_body("skip_whitespace").is_none()`; both now assert the denotation exists, and every other claim in both tests (the mirror body's Inconclusive, the seed-kind emptiness, the pool verdicts under (a)/(b)) passes unmoved. The Phase 90 probes stand as the measurement record and all pass — their next_char calls now resolve through production `sym_invoke` first (the probe map remains as the statement-mode fallback), with identical verdicts including the ignored symbolic STEP instrument. **Regression — the frozen standings do not move:** cross-validation ×3 runs identical to the Phase 86 freeze as amended by Phases 87/91 (classifiers Verified + 774/774 each; peek/next_char Verified + 39/39; skip_whitespace modal 4/12 with the freeze's own recorded E0689 draw in run 3; tokenize_one Verified winner, executed 0/10 on the E0308 class; tokenize_all Inconclusive 0/8, template crowned in run 3 as recorded); the Codegen probe holds **129/129 winners Verified in all 3 runs** (the record-completion entry declines on the Codegen non-goal shapes — String returns, not records — and every recognized Codegen spec denotes earlier in the chain); `morphic check examples/functional_tokenizer.morph` valid; production changes confined to `src/synthesis/engine.rs` (the chain, the two keyed builders, the STEP extraction), the verifier's diff is tests plus the two re-pins only, the examples file untouched, no spec amended (R1/R2 land in Phase 96). **Suites: 509/0/30 default, 509/0/30 bootstrap-codegen, 407/0/22 no-Z3** (baselines 504/504/405; the delta is exactly the +5 new tests — 2 engine tests in all configurations, 3 verifier tests Z3-gated). **What waits for Phase 93, stated plainly:** every symbolic judgment whose path passes through a While/Loop body — skip's self-judgment, the STEP/LOOP verdicts, tokenize_all's row over a denoted step — plus the invariant route (Phase 96) for any symbolic Verified of a loop body. Next: Phase 93 (statement-mode encoder + bounded unrolling, L).

> **Phase 93 (2026-11-22, branch `feat/encoder-ext-93-statement-encoder`) — statement-mode encoder BUILT (design doc §2.2/§2.7 Layer 1): statement-shaped bodies are judged by production code under the exact BMC discipline, and the tokenize pair's symbolic split moves exactly where the design said it would — the STEP body is now REFUTED by its own standing rows, and nothing else moves.** **What was built** (all in `src/verify/verifier.rs`; no synthesis-side change was needed): a path-state statement evaluator (`sym_eval_stmt`) beside the expression encoder, reusing its primitives (`sym_eval` / `sym_invoke` / `sym_match` / `sym_ite` / `sym_binop_ir`) for every value it can, covering Block / Alloc / Assign / While / Loop / Break / TryPropagate and the denoted compositions; and a statement judge (`verify_constraint_stmt`) implementing §2.2 verbatim — **Proven ⟺** no completed path violates the row **∧** exhaustion is UNSAT; **Refuted ⟺** a countermodel exists on a completed path; otherwise **Unknown**, never a guess. Unrolling is solver-guided (branch conditions decided against path assumptions; only genuinely free conditions split or merge), term equality is Z3 node identity throughout (the Phase 90 Debug-string trap, 96 s vs O(1), is designed out), and exhaustion is a first-class outcome carried on every evaluation — a fuel cut is never an exit and never a failure. **Routing:** `verify_one` engages the statement layer only where the expression encoder declines (`sym_eval` → None) **and** the body syntactically mentions statement/loop nodes, in itself or transitively in a callee's denotation (`body_mentions_statements`, depth-capped, cycle-guarded); every other body — including bodies the expression encoder declines for non-statement reasons — follows the pre-Phase-93 path bit-identically, and the routing gate itself is pinned by a tooth (an unarmed (String, Char) Append body keeps its standing Inconclusive even though the statement layer's own Append could evaluate it: routing, not capability, decides). **Fuel:** battery/point callers pass the measured trip-count derivations (skip = trip count; STEP = max(skip_trips, ident_trips+1); LOOP = max(outer incl. the final no-progress call, inner)); `verify_one`'s symbolic judging uses `STMT_VERIFY_FUEL = 1` — every measured symbolic outcome is already decided at fuel 1 (skip Unknown, STEP row 2 Refuted, LOOP Unknown), fuel 2 on the LOOP shape exceeded a 280 s wall in Phase 90's probe and is disqualifying at any cap the verifier runs, and the discipline is sound at any fuel, so the constant is a cost decision, recorded in its doc comment. Solver caps are the verifier's own (the per-constraint timeout; a cap hit surfaces as Unknown by construction). **The selector-facing verdict contract, stated for Phases 95/97:** statement judging emits ONLY the existing verdict vocabulary — per-row `ConstraintResult { holds }`, the candidate `VerificationStatus` (Verified / VerificationFailed / Inconclusive), and a counterexample on refutation — the same values `composite_score` and the refutation gate already consume for expression-mode candidates, read identically. A statement-bodied candidate is Verified iff every row is Proven under the discipline, which requires exhaustion UNSAT — unreachable for unbounded-loop bodies over symbolic inputs at any sound fuel — so until Phase 96's invariants land, template/denotation bodies can surface as **VerificationFailed** (a completed-path refutation exists) or **Inconclusive**, and not as Verified. **The selector gains no Verified-preference from this phase:** selection reads status + tpr exactly as before; a statement-mode VerificationFailed is an ordinary refutation and an Inconclusive the standing neutral outcome. **Evidence (production code paths; six new `phase93_*` tests):** the point batteries re-decided exactly — skip **12/12** (outputs mirror-exact at fuel = trip count, unresolved one fuel below; current rows and strengthening row (a) Proven at all 12 through the production judge; judge time 0–3 ms per point); STEP **10/10** at the predicted fuels (Ok outputs mirror-exact, both rows Proven at Ok points; at the Err point row 1 (index 0) Unknown — the W8 literal-Err unwrap boundary — and row 2 (index 1) Proven; judge 0–69 ms per point); LOOP **8/8** over the production STEP denotation (token lists exact; the row Proven at Ok sources, Unknown at the Err source; judge 0–1 ms). **Symbolic:** skip over a fully symbolic state judges Unknown at fuels 1/2/4 under the current rows and under (a), with the mechanism pinned — the outcome's exhaustion is satisfiable at every fuel (judge 75/98/302 ms); the Forall row (c) also judges Unknown but by the other mechanism (its encoding is Phase 94's arm), and the test names the difference so the two Unknowns are never conflated. The STEP denotation symbolically: row 1 Unknown (8 ms), row 2 **Refuted** (645 ms) — `verify_one` returns **VerificationFailed with a counterexample** (wall 3,226 ms), and at the concrete `" 5"` point the production judge Refutes row 2 over the production outcome end to end (the R2-β-skip residue, reproduced through production denotations + production judging). The LOOP body and the skip denotation as candidates stay **Inconclusive** (walls 5,602 ms / 19 ms — inside the verifier's caps, surfaced honestly). **Teeth, all through the production judge:** identity-as-skip at a whitespace start (current rows Proven — the standing scandal — row (a) Refuted); partial skip ((a) Refutes it on a run of 5, Proves it on a run of 1); a double-append step body at `":"` (row 1 Refuted, row 2 Proven — the count discriminates, not the tag); the STEP denotation with its EOF branches swapped (row 1 Refuted at `"spec"`). **The one designed movement, and the one re-pin:** `phase92_statement_denotations_manufacture_no_verdicts` is re-pinned in place with its reason recorded — the skip half's Inconclusive now arrives BY JUDGING (exhaustion), and the STEP half moves Inconclusive → VerificationFailed (standing row 2 refutes the faithful body; §2.7 Layer 1's stated product). In pool synthesis the tokenize_one template candidate's verdict moves the same way; its selection standing is unchanged in kind (tpr still 0.000 — the interpreter cannot execute it until Phase 95 — and it did not crown before and does not now; measured pool outcomes in the harness re-run are identical). **Two design-doc readings clarified in the building (recorded, not silently deviated):** (1) §2.7's "extends `sym_eval_flow` itself / no assembly layer" is built as a sibling path-state evaluator reusing the same primitives, with per-callee assembly retained at statement boundaries — the literal signature-extension reading is not implementable, because guided mode needs explicit path-condition/environment state that `sym_eval`'s single-value return cannot carry; the doc's intent (production judging in the verifier, no test-only assembly) is met, and the assembly is exactly the discipline §2.2's own probe specified. (2) §2.5/Phase 91 left (String, Char-scalar) Append unarmed; production confirms the STEP ident arm needs exactly that arm at concrete points (Index into a string yields a Char scalar there) — it is armed ONLY in the statement layer (`stmt_append`), and the expression encoder keeps Phase 91's decline. Relatedly, `encodable.rs` is **unchanged**: it mirrors `sym_eval`'s contract, which is untouched — the statement layer is a judging layer whose outcomes depend on solver-guided decisions and are not abstractable into the pure predicate, so seed admission and the no-Z3 build's honest Inconclusive for such bodies are exactly as before. A valued `Break` declines in the statement evaluator (the probe ignored the value; production takes the conservative side — no measured body uses one). **Probe retirement: none.** Every Phase 90 probe stands — the point batteries are now duplicated by production tests, but the probes remain the measurement record (the naive-merging cost curve, the term-equality trap, the ignored symbolic instruments) under the same precedent as Phases 91/92, and all pass unmoved. **Regression — the frozen standings do not move:** cross-validation ×3 runs identical to the Phase 92 record (classifiers Verified + 774/774 each; peek/next_char Verified + 39/39; skip_whitespace modal 4/12 with the freeze's own recorded E0689 draw; tokenize template agreement 9/10 + 7/8, sole deviation the Err message text); the Codegen probe holds **129/129 winners Verified in all 3 runs** (387/387 winner lines, 0 false); `morphic check examples/functional_tokenizer.morph` valid; the expression encoder's core functions (`sym_eval`, `sym_eval_flow`, `sym_match`, `encode_constraint`, `verify_constraint`) are byte-identical to the branch base; production changes confined to `src/verify/verifier.rs`, the examples file untouched, no spec amended (R1/R2 land in Phase 96). **Suites: 515/0/30 default, 515/0/30 bootstrap-codegen, 407/0/22 no-Z3** (baselines 509/509/407; the delta is exactly the +6 new tests, all Z3-gated). **What waits, stated plainly:** symbolic Verified for any loop body is Phase 96's invariant route (this phase proves the corollary in production: unrolling alone never gets there); the template bodies' tpr is Phase 95's interpreter subset; the Forall arm is Phase 94's. Next: Phase 94 (Forall encoding, S–M).

> **Phase 94 (2026-11-22, branch `feat/encoder-ext-94-forall`) — Forall encoding BUILT (design doc §3.3): the (c) row's boundary — Phase 80's option-D wall — is removed; `encode_constraint` now encodes `Constraint::Forall`, and the row decides everywhere Phase 90 measured it would.** **What was built** (all in `src/verify/verifier.rs`): a `forall_const` arm in `encode_constraint` — the binders bound as fresh Int constants in a cloned env, the body encoded through the same recursive encoder, closed with `z3::ast::forall_const` with **no trigger patterns** (Phase 90 measured the bare form decisive everywhere — points 0–25 ms, the invariant consecution 5 ms bare vs 6 ms with an `str.at` pattern — and a pattern is a second mechanism that can only restrict instantiation). **The accepted envelope is the measured one, and everything outside it declines whole (None), never partially:** every binder `Int` (the CharStr bridge speaks Int indices); a non-empty, duplicate-free binder list; a quantifier-free body (a nested `Forall`/`Exists` anywhere in the body declines, via a syntactic guard — nesting is unmeasured); a body the encoder can express with the binders bound. `Exists` and `Predicate` are unmoved. **Two recorded dispositions:** (1) the design's "(+ `encodable.rs` mirror)" — `encodable.rs` is **unchanged by design**, under the Phase 93 precedent: it abstracts `sym_eval_flow` (bodies) for the no-Z3 predicate, and `encode_constraint` is a Z3-only surface with no pure counterpart, so the arm has no mirror surface; nothing in the pure predicate can disagree about a constraint it never judges. (2) The bounded-expansion fallback (§3.3's S-priced companion) is **NOT built — recorded measured-unnecessary**: the quantifier arm decided every point, tooth and symbolic case in the battery below, so there is no measured shape left for a fallback to cover; building it would be speculation, and the probe's bounded encoder stands in the test suite as the record that the form exists if a future shape resists. **Evidence (four new `phase94_*` tests, production machinery throughout):** at the 12 skip battery points the (c) row is **Proven 12/12 through `encode_constraint`** (formula-level judging, 0–69 ms per point — the 69 ms is the mid-string-start point; the rest ≤ 5 ms) with the Phase 90 probe encoder's verdict cross-checked equal at every point, and **Proven 12/12 through the production statement judge** over the Phase 92 denotation's outcomes at trip-count fuel (1–55 ms per point; exhaustion UNSAT at every point, as the BMC discipline requires for Proven). **Teeth:** both overshoot outputs (`"a b"` → 2, `"ab cd"` → 3) **Refuted** (3 ms each); at the whitespace point the identity and partial outputs are **admitted by (c)** (Proven — their crossings are all whitespace) and **Refuted by row (a)**, and the mirror's output is Proven under both — the exact pin is (a)+(c) jointly, neither row oversold, exactly the division of labor Phase 87 priced and Phase 90 measured. **The symbolic flip, decomposed:** over the denoted skip body's symbolic outcome at fuel 4, (c) now **encodes on every completed path and no completed path refutes it** (pc ∧ ¬exhausted ∧ ¬(c) UNSAT per path), while exhaustion stays satisfiable — so the aggregate verdict is **Unknown by the exhaustion gate alone**, and `phase93_stmt_skip_symbolic_unknown`'s (c) block is re-pinned in place to assert the encoding exists and name the new mechanism (the two Unknowns remain un-conflated; Phase 96's invariant route is still the designated path to a symbolic Verified, unchanged). **Wrong free outputs over a fully symbolic state** (per row through `verify_constraint`): identity — (c) **Proven** (vacuous range, 4 ms), (a) **Refuted** (4 ms); the pos+2 overshoot — (c) **Refuted** (48 ms), (a) Refuted (6 ms); a bare pos+1 output — (c) **Refuted** (7 ms): (c) admits a partial BODY only through its path condition in the statement judge, never a bare advance whose crossing is unproven. **Envelope pins:** Char and String binders decline; empty and duplicate binder lists decline; a nested Forall (bare, and under an And in the body) declines; a Predicate body declines; `Exists` still declines; two-Int-binder Foralls encode and decide (a tautology Proven, 3 ms; the strict-order claim Refuted, 2 ms). **Quantifier-instantiation blowups: none observed** — the worst single judgment in the phase is 69 ms at a point and 48 ms on the symbolic overshoot refutation, all far inside the per-constraint caps. **Re-pins in place with reasons:** the Phase 87 strengthening test's and the Phase 90 measurement's assertions that the production encoder returns None for a Forall (both flipped to Some, their tests otherwise unmoved — the Phase 90 probe suite stands entire as the measurement record). **Regression — the frozen standings do not move:** the full suites carry the cross-validation harness and the Codegen probe (129/129 ×3) green exactly as at Phase 93; `morphic check examples/functional_tokenizer.morph` valid; the one deliberate change to the expression encoder's core is this phase's arm itself (`encode_constraint`); production changes confined to `src/verify/verifier.rs`, `encodable.rs` untouched, the examples file untouched, **no spec amended** (the (c) row's adoption into `skip_whitespace` is R1's, executed in Phase 96 — here the row is judged only from the Phase 90 scratch surgery). **Suites: 519/0/30 default, 519/0/30 bootstrap-codegen, 407/0/22 no-Z3** (baselines 515/515/407; the delta is exactly the +4 new tests, all Z3-gated, so the no-Z3 count is unmoved). Next: Phase 95 (interpreter statement/loop subset, M) and Phase 96 (invariants + R1/R2 ratifications, L).

> **Phase 95 (2026-11-22, branch `feat/encoder-ext-95-interpreter`) — interpreter statement/loop subset BUILT (design doc W9): the in-process interpreter evaluates statement-shaped bodies, and the tokenize template bodies earn their battery standings through the in-process path for the first time.** **What was built** (all in `src/synthesis/eval.rs`; the harness evidence test lives in `src/tokenizer_cross_validation.rs`): the evaluator's flow discipline gains the statement layer — `Flow::Broke(Option<Value>)` beside Normal/Returned, and arms for **Block** (sequencing; flows propagate), **Alloc** (evaluates its initial and binds it; the Alloc's own value is the bound value), **Assign** (rebinds an already-bound variable — an unbound target and a non-variable target are each named `NotEvaluable`, never a silent creation or a guess), **While** (condition must evaluate to Bool; an unvalued Break exits with Unit), **Loop** (a Break's value, or Unit, is the loop's value), **Break** (outside a loop: named failure), and **TryPropagate** over Result values (an Ok payload continues as the value; an Err unwinds the enclosing body with that Err as its result — the compiled `?`; a non-Result operand is named). **Termination discipline:** one iteration budget per top-level `eval` call, shared across nested loops — `MAX_LOOP_ITERATIONS = 10_000`, decremented once per While/Loop body iteration; exceeding it is `NotEvaluable` naming the bound, never a hang and never a fabricated value. The bound's rationale is recorded at the constant: the tokenizer batteries' real trip counts are a few hundred iterations in total for the composed LOOP body over the longest battery source, so 10,000 is more than 10× headroom, while a runaway body still resolves in milliseconds of trivial iterations. **The one declined form, named:** a *valued* Break inside a **While** — the compiled language gives `while` no break value (a Rust `while` cannot break with one), so the form is declined in the reason text rather than assigned a guessed meaning; the same form inside a `Loop` is the loop's value, as compiled. **Constructor-pattern Match** (`bind_pattern`): `Some`/`None`/`Ok`/`Err` match their value families with the payload bound by the single sub-pattern, recursively (nested constructor patterns match nested values); a record constructor names a `Value::Record`'s type and binds its fields positionally in written order (the record value's own convention); a constructor against a different family simply does not match (the next arm is tried, as the compiled runner falls through); an arity contradiction against the matching family is a named decline. **Clone** is the identity over immutable values (the encoder's W3 reading, Phase 91). **Append** gains the (Str, Char) lexeme arm and statement-position write-back when its target is a bound Var (the compiled rendering is a push on the binding; every other target shape keeps the pure form). **String Index totalizes** to the NUL sentinel out of range — parity with the compiled rendering (`chars().nth(i).unwrap_or('\0')`, Phase 85) and the CharStr bridge; the ident loop's end-of-input read depends on it (the sentinel is not an ident-continue char, so the loop breaks exactly where peek's None breaks it); list Index stays an error, the compiled Vec index being a panic — a non-answer either way. **The composition boundary rule, measured into existence:** a Block in a value position (an Alloc initializer, an Assign value, a TryPropagate operand — the positions the harness's in-process composition inlines callee bodies into) is a *body*: its Return is its result, absorbed as the block's value (`eval_body_value`); every other node in those positions propagates its flows untouched. Two drafts were measured wrong and corrected in-phase: propagating Returned there made the composed tokenize_one body exit at its skip prefix and judge nothing; reading Returned as a value unconditionally swallowed the LOOP body's own `?` unwind through its Alloc (`let step = tokenize_one(s)?` must unwind on Err, and does). **Evidence** (harness test `phase95_template_bodies_evaluate_in_process`, production machinery throughout): the template bodies composed exactly as this harness has always composed them — named calls resolved against the production denotations (`SpecIndex::callee_body`: the Phase 92/93 statement denotations for skip_whitespace/tokenize_one, the dual-registered record-completion body for next_char) via `resolve_body`, the LOOP body drawn from a real synthesis pool as in Phase 85 — evaluate **in-process** at the compiled runner's standings: **tokenize_one 9/10, tokenize_all 7/8** against the batteries, the sole disagreement in each being the Err message text at the `"5"` / `"spec 5"` point (F2 — the tag agrees, the text is the constant), and **2/2 + 2/2** on the two specs' own tests through `run_spec_tests`. **Pool tpr, measured and reported as-is:** both raw template seeds still score **0.000** in pool judging, and no selection standing moves — the pool judges the RAW bodies, whose named calls to sibling functions the context-free interpreter declines (a named call is not a value; that is G4's neighbour and it is unchanged by design — this phase's subset is the statement layer, not a module context). Phase 93's "tpr 0.000 pending Phase 95" is therefore answered precisely: the subset's effect is on composed bodies (the batteries above), not on the raw pool score; what a crowning campaign can use in Phase 97 is that statement-shaped bodies are now *judgeable* in-process wherever a composition supplies their callees. **Teeth:** a non-terminating While and a bare Loop each judge `NotEvaluable` by the bound, promptly (the counting-to-9,999 control passes, so the bound is a bound, not a ban); the identity body still fails skip_whitespace's golden tests in-process ({evaluable 2, passed 1} — it passes "no-whitespace", fails "skip-spaces", the α spec-strength fact, not an interpreter gap); an unconditional single advance fails both ({2, 0} — it moves on "hi" and stops after one space on "  hi"); swapped Match arms give the opposite answer on the same scrutinee; the declined valued-Break-in-While stays `NotEvaluable` and is named; a statement-shaped mirror skip body (hand-composed over the local `cur`, peek/next_char inlined) passes skip's golden tests 2/2 in-process and advances line/col correctly over a newline run. **The Phase 75 residual list, restated shrunken** — closed by this phase: TryPropagate `NotEvaluable`; constructor patterns never matching in-process; the statement/loop nodes (Block sequencing over Alloc/Assign/While/Loop/Break) outside the subset; Clone `NotEvaluable`. **What remains, exactly:** **G4** — interpreter function values (Lambda/Closure values, and calls to non-builtin functions), untouched as instructed: sort/binary_search judging stays blocked exactly as before; **For** (no measured statement body uses it); **Head/Tail/Init/Last/Reverse** (no measured consumer); **Match guard patterns** (an unparsed string condition cannot be decided honestly); the declined valued-Break-in-While (by design, named); list Index out-of-bounds (an error, the compiled panic's analogue). **Re-pins in place, each with its reason recorded:** `eval_not_evaluable_nodes` (Alloc leaves the list; its While case now judges by the bound, its Assign case by the unbound-target rule), `valued_test_count_distinguishes_wrong_from_unevaluable` (the Alloc/Return body now answers — valued 3; a For body is the still-unevaluable example), `try_propagate_remains_outside_the_evaluable_subset` → `try_propagate_evaluates_result_threading` (the residual it pinned is closed), and the Phase 75 headline test's skip comment (its degenerate body is now judged by the bound, not by shape; the run's shape is unchanged). **Regression — the frozen standings do not move:** cross-validation harness identical (classifiers 774/774 each, peek 39/39, next_char 39/39 + secondary 39/39, skip/tokenize rows at their standing values across 3 runs); Codegen probe 129/129 winners Verified in all 3 runs; `morphic check examples/functional_tokenizer.morph` valid; the examples file untouched; **no spec amended** (R1/R2 land in Phase 96). **Suites: 528/0/30 default, 528/0/30 bootstrap-codegen, 416/0/22 no-Z3** (baselines 519/519/407; the +9 delta is exactly this phase's new tests — 8 in eval.rs, 1 in the harness — in every configuration, none of them Z3-gated). Next: Phase 96 (loop invariants + R1/R2 ratifications, L), then Phase 97 (crowning + gate re-run #3, M).
> **Phase 96 (2026-11-22, branch `feat/encoder-ext-96-invariants-amendments`) — loop invariants BUILT (design doc §3.2) and the ratified round-3 amendments APPLIED (R1 + R2): the denoted skip body Verifies symbolically against the strengthened spec, and the tokenize pair's remaining distance collapses to one named boundary.** **WS1 — the invariant machinery** (all in `src/verify/verifier.rs` unless noted): `IRNode::Loop` gains the `invariant: Option<String>` field its `While` sibling already carried (a field addition to an existing variant — no IR kind code moves; every construction/match site updated, renderers ignore it exactly as they treat a While invariant as comment text, so the M3 corpus is byte-identical). The invariant text is **spec-syntax constraint rows over the loop's environment** — the function's parameters plus every local bound before the loop, by name, in the module dialect — one row per `;`-separated piece, parsed by the spec parser's own constraint parser (new public entry `parse_constraint_text` in `src/spec/parser.rs`), their conjunction being the invariant; it may not reference `output` or any variable first bound inside the body (an unbound name fails the scope check and the route declines). **The route is lazy-hybrid, a clarification recorded here in the Phase 93 fuel precedent's spirit:** the brief's "the invariant route INSTEAD of unrolling" is realized as — Phase 93's unrolling runs first on a cloned state and is adopted untouched when it completes without new exhaustion (at concrete points it is exact, and the 12/10/8 point batteries' mirror-exactness depends on that), and only where unrolling cannot complete does the invariant route engage, on the untouched entry state. The route discharges the classic three obligations — **initiation** (invariant holds on loop entry), **consecution** (one arbitrary iteration from an arbitrary invariant state preserves it, evaluated once over a havoc'd loop-head state), **exit** (the post-loop state is an arbitrary invariant state with the condition false: written variables havoc'd to fresh values of their shapes under a per-evaluation unique tag, invariant ∧ ¬condition conjoined into the path condition; for the Loop form, every break path's state must satisfy the invariant) — and any obligation that does not discharge (a solver SAT or Unknown on a negated obligation, an unencodable row, a body evaluation that declines or exhausts during consecution, a While whose body breaks out of itself) fails the route into the Phase 93 **exhaustion verdict, never a pass**. Return paths recorded during consecution are carried into the caller's return set (they over-approximate the real in-loop returns — the judge checks rows over a superset of paths, which can cost verdicts but never invent a Proven; a Refuted drawn from such a path is the route's one documented over-approximation). Two supporting mechanisms the workstreams required: **single-path fact export** — a callee whose statement outcome has exactly one completed path exports that path's condition into the caller's path condition (the frame facts a caller row reads travel with the value; multi-path callees export nothing), and **constraint-call resolution** — both judges now resolve statement-bodied calls inside a row (R2's `skip_whitespace(state)`) through the statement layer before encoding, substituting a fresh variable bound to the callee's single-path value and asserting its path condition as facts (identical calls resolve once per row; a call under a quantifier binder its arguments mention declines; any non-single-path or exhaustion-reachable outcome declines, and the row falls back to the plain encoding that declines at the same call — Unknown either way; rows without such calls are untouched, bit for bit). **The authored invariants, all discharging:** skip's While — source frame, token-count frame, pos progress floor, and the ∀-between fact in row (c)'s own shape (whole-route symbolic evaluation **13 ms** at the production fuel; Phase 90 measured the ∀ consecution alone at 5–6 ms); the STEP ident Loop — source frame, token-count frame, pos floor (inside STEP's symbolic evaluation, whose outcome exhaustion is now **UNSAT**); the LOOP token-accumulation loop — the token-length floor alone (the source frame is deliberately not claimed: it is not provable through the multi-path STEP assembly, and tokenize_all's row needs only the length fact; whole-body symbolic evaluation **2,866 ms**, the cost being the consecution's one-iteration evaluation of STEP's twelve paths over the havoc'd state). Failure discipline is pinned by test: a false invariant, an out-of-scope invariant, and a malformed invariant each yield satisfiable exhaustion and Unknown verdicts — never a pass, never a refutation. **WS2 — R1 applied** (`examples/functional_tokenizer.morph`, round-3 amendment record in the module header): skip_whitespace gains row (a) `output.pos >= len(output.source) || is_whitespace(output.source[output.pos]) == false` and row (c) `forall i: Int in range(len(output.source)): i < state.pos || i >= output.pos || is_whitespace(output.source[i])`, the two original rows unmoved. Evidence: the denoted body **Verifies symbolically** against the strengthened spec (`verify_one` Verified, 95 ms; all four rows Proven through the statement judge); executed agreement stays mirror-exact on the 12-point battery (the Phase 93 battery, its below-fuel block re-pinned — below the trip count the invariant route now resolves by proof, and every row still Proves at the point); **the teeth flip**: the identity body and the partial-skip body, admitted under the old rows (the identity was the standing Verified winner), are **VerificationFailed at candidate level**, and row-level teeth stand per row ((a) refutes identity and partial; (c) refutes the overshoots, vacuous at zero progress). **WS3 — R2 applied**: tokenize_one's row 2 gains the β-skip license — the R2-α license re-read at the post-skip position with a callee call in the row: `|| (skip_whitespace(state).pos < len(skip_whitespace(state).source) && is_ident_start(skip_whitespace(state).source[skip_whitespace(state).pos]) == false && is_whitespace(…) == false && … != ':' && … != '='` (the nine punctuation disequalities at the skipped position; the leading guard is the EOF clause — skip landing at end-of-input licenses no Err). Before→after, measured: the standing row's verdict on the faithful Err at `" 5"` flips **Refuted → Proven** at the point (both judges), in the production-denotation batteries, and symbolically (the Phase 84/90/92/93 pins re-pinned in place); the STEP candidate flips **VerificationFailed → Inconclusive**, its row 2 **Proven symbolically** and its row 1 Unknown — with the blocker named to the path: the outcome's exhaustion is UNSAT and row 1 encodes on **11 of 12** outcome paths, failing only on the literal-Err path, where `output.unwrap()` is the **W8 boundary** (the is_err disjunct would admit that path, but a row encodes whole or not at all). The license's teeth: fabricated Errs at post-skip identifier start, post-skip punctuation, and post-skip end-of-input all stay **Refuted**; a faithful Err past a nonzero position (pos 2 of `"a 5"`) is admitted. **The LOOP / tokenize_all standing:** Inconclusive — its accumulation loop closes by invariant (outcome exhaustion UNSAT), and its one row encodes on the Ok exit path and declines on the propagated Err paths, the **same W8 boundary**: W8 is the whole of what blocks both tokenize specs, and it is an encoder-boundary item, not a spec or machinery gap. **Cross-validation harness re-run (3 runs × 8 specs), the harness's own numbers:** classifiers **EXACT** (Verified, 774/774, golden 3/3, all runs); peek **EXACT** (Verified, 39/39); next_char **EXACT** (Verified, 39/39 + secondary 39/39); skip_whitespace **PARTIAL** — winners **Inconclusive in all three runs** (tpr 0.000/0.500/0.000; the pre-R1 Verified crown is gone — R1's harness-level effect, exactly as Phase 87 priced: under (a)+(c) no pool body verifies, the faithful body being the denotation, not a pool candidate), stated-postconditions agreement [12, 12, 0/12], full mirror agreement [4, 4, 0/12] (run 3 is the recorded non-terminating-winner draw); the harness's verdict text for skip still narrates "(only two postconditions)" — **stale instrument narration** now that the spec carries four rows, recorded here and left unedited mid-measurement per the Phase 76 precedent (a Phase 97 sweep item); tokenize_one **PARTIAL** (Verified Mutation crowns at tpr 0.500, executed 0/10 with the standing rustc E0308 draw — the Verified∧exact split unmoved in shape); tokenize_all **PARTIAL** (Inconclusive, 0/8). **Codegen probe 129/129** holds (the full suites carry it); playground corpus re-synced byte-identical after the amendment — **13/13 check + 5/5 synthesis**; `morphic check` valid on the amended module; **in-spec tests still 18/18** (the amendments change constraints only — no test moved, none contradicted). **Re-pins in place, each with its reason recorded:** the Phase 84 pair (the `" 5"` residue flips to admission; row 2's encodability restated through the resolution, with the β admission added at the symbolic path), Phase 87's strengthening measurement (its baseline made explicit as the two original rows now that the strengthened rows are the standing ones), the Phase 90 pair (identity teeth per-row under the four standing rows; the `" 5"` diagnostic flips), the Phase 92 pair (skip Verifies through its denotation; STEP Inconclusive), the Phase 93 four (the points battery's below-fuel block; the skip-symbolic test now pins BOTH halves — stripped body: corollary intact, production body: Verified; the STEP symbolic test's full restatement; the teeth loop), and Phase 94's symbolic mechanism (exhaustion UNSAT, (c) Proven). **What Phase 97 inherits, plainly:** (1) the **W8 literal-Err unwrap boundary** — the single remaining block to Verified for both tokenize denotations (make row judging per-disjunct on literal-tag paths, or encode `unwrap` on a literal Err as a don't-care under its guarding disjunct — an encoder decision, priced there); (2) the **crowning question** — the faithful skip/tokenize bodies Verify as denotations and compositions, but synthesis pools contain no such bodies, and the raw template seeds still judge **tpr 0.000** in pool judging (Phase 95's finding stands: pool judging is context-free, compositions are the judgeable unit), so a crown needs a route that puts a faithful body in a pool or crowns a composition; (3) **R3/F2** — the Err-message text still caps executed-exact at 9/10 + 7/8 (owner decision, deferred to this gate); (4) the harness's stale skip narration ("(only two postconditions)"); (5) the invariant route's named edges — a While whose body breaks out of itself declines the route, and in-loop Return paths are judged as the documented over-approximation. **Suites: 533/0/30 default, 533/0/30 bootstrap-codegen, 416/0/22 no-Z3** (baselines 528/528/416; > **Phase 97 (2026-11-22, branch `feat/encoder-ext-97-crowning-gate`) — W8 FIXED by per-disjunct judging, the CROWNING CAMPAIGN executed (all three composition candidates take the crown), and the M1 GATE RE-RUN #3: NOT PASS by exactly one sliver — the owner-named F2 Err-message text; (α) is CLOSED, (β) is CLOSED modulo that cap.** Nothing was amended in this phase: no spec row moved, the gate text is untouched, the mirror's message is untouched, and F2 was not built — the owner's 2026-11-22 ruling names the cap (executed-exact for the tokenize pair caps at 9/10 + 7/8 on the Err message text only) and defers the F2 decision itself until after this verdict. **WS1 — the W8 fix (all in `src/verify/verifier.rs`; the encoder is untouched — `encode_expr`'s unwrap arm still declines on a literal Err, its comment now pointing at the judge-level recovery):** of the two routes Phase 96 priced, **(i) per-disjunct judging is implemented; (ii) totalized unwrap is measured and REJECTED as a standalone route.** The measurement that decides it: with a don't-care Int payload substituted for the declined unwrap, the unguarded tooth row's formula is satisfiable AND its negation is satisfiable — a totalized verdict there would be the substituted term's choice, not the row's meaning — while on the real rows route (ii) decides exactly where route (i) decides (on row 1's literal-Err path, pc ∧ ¬row is UNSAT under ANY payload term, because the path's `is_err()` disjunct already decides the row); (i) therefore subsumes (ii)'s entire sound content and abstains precisely where (ii) fabricates. The mechanism: when a row's whole-formula encoding declines, the row is split into its top-level disjuncts (`Constraint::Or` parts, or the Expr-level left-associative `||` chain flattened — the real rows mix both shapes; a split yielding fewer than two parts is no split); each disjunct is encoded in the caller's own session shape, and if at least one disjunct declined AND at least one encoded, the judge asks whether facts ∧ ¬(the union of the encodable disjuncts) is UNSAT. Soundness, recorded in the helper: the real formula is E ∨ D, so ¬(E∨D) ⊆ ¬E — any countermodel of the row would countermodel E; UNSAT of the weaker negation therefore Proves the row, SAT proves nothing (Unknown), and **the fallback never Refutes**. Wiring: `verify_constraint` collects the D5a side conditions into a Vec before the encode branch so the whole-row and fallback sessions assert them identically; `verify_constraint_stmt` applies the same recovery per outcome path (a recovered path is decided and the walk continues; an unrecovered one marks the body Unknown — continue, never Refuted; a row with no split keeps the standing immediate Unknown). **Measured:** STEP's row 1 encodes on 11 of 12 outcome paths whole and recovers the twelfth (the literal-Err path) — it now **decides on all 12 paths and is Proven symbolically**; tokenize_all's row has two outcome paths (the Ok exit and the propagated Err), one whole + one recovered — **Proven**. Candidate verdicts: the STEP denotation flips **Inconclusive → Verified** (1,350 ms) and the LOOP body flips **Inconclusive → Verified** (2,431 ms) — both were Phase 96's named residue, and nothing else stood behind them. **The tooth holds, pinned by test:** a scratch row that genuinely reads the unwrapped value on an Err path with no deciding guard still declines (Unknown) through both judges; `is_ok() || unwrap == 3` at a literal Err is Unknown (a false guard decides nothing); the unguarded growth-read core of row 1 through the statement judge is Unknown; where a row encodes whole, its semantics are intact (the same scratch family Proves Ok(3) and Refutes Ok(4)); and the Phase 76 literal-Err Eq pin (`output == Err("x").unwrap()` → Inconclusive) survives untouched — the recovery is a property of disjunctive rows on literal-tag paths, not a general weakening. **Eleven standing pins re-pinned in place, each with its reason recorded in its test** (the Phase 84 pair, Phase 87's strengthening measurement, the Phase 90 pair, the Phase 92 battery, the Phase 93 four, the Phase 96 LOOP standing test): every one is a W8-artifact expectation — Unknown/Inconclusive at a site the recovery now decides Proven/Verified — and per-path ENCODE counts are unmoved everywhere, the pins now stating that recovery is a judge-level fact over an untouched encoder. Three new tests pin the mechanism, the tooth, and the route-(ii) rejection measurement. **WS2 — the crowning campaign (`src/tokenizer_cross_validation.rs`):** the harness gains a **composition candidate** for each of skip_whitespace / tokenize_one / tokenize_all — the spec's resolver denotation (tokenize_all: the pool's template LOOP body, composed over the STEP denotation by the resolver and the member closure), provenance `phase97_composition`, the other five specs keeping their standing pool crowns — judged by the SAME two standards as any crown: (a) Z3 via `verify_one` on the denotation/LOOP body against the spec's current rows; (b) executed agreement against the golden battery on BOTH execution routes, cross-checked against each other — the compiled runner over one generated function per spec (denotation bodies, named calls kept: this harness's standing architecture for record specs) and the Phase 95 in-process route over the textually resolved composition. Two emitter facts shape the compiled route, both measured in this phase and recorded in the harness: the fully resolved body cannot be emitted — a denotation's Return is function-scoped in the emitter but block-scoped in the interpreter, so an inlined skip Returns from tokenize_one itself (rustc E0308) — and next_char's raw denotation cannot be emitted either (its guard calls `peek(state)` by value and the record literal then reads `state`, E0382); the compiled map therefore carries next_char in its **production inlined form** (the `inline_calls` body — `record_completion_seed_body`'s standing answer to the same fact) and the denotations for every other member. The crown rule is stated in the harness header and applied mechanically: the composition takes the crown iff it is Z3-Verified, its compiled agreement is at least the pool winner's in every run, and it meets the two standards strictly better somewhere (a run of higher agreement, or a tie against an unverified pool winner). **The crowns (composition measured once — the bodies are deterministic — and re-measured identically inside the full 3-run harness):** skip_whitespace — composition **Verified (rows 4/4), executed 12/12 compiled + 12/12 in-process**, original-two-rows projection 12/12, against pool winners Inconclusive at [4, 4, 4]/12: **the composition takes the crown**, and the faithful skip is mirror-exact under the strengthened spec for the first time. tokenize_one — composition **Verified (rows 2/2), executed 9/10 compiled + 9/10 in-process**, the sole disagreement on each route the Err text at `"5"` (winner `ERR|"Unexpected character"`, mirror `ERR|"Unexpected character '5' at line 1"` — the tags agree; this is the **F2 cap**, named) — against pool winners Verified but executed 0/10 (rustc E0308): **the composition takes the crown**. tokenize_all — composition **Verified (row 1/1), executed 7/8 + 7/8**, the sole disagreement the same F2 text at `"spec 5"` — against pool winners executed 0/8 (E0308): **the composition takes the crown**. One pool movement, recorded exactly: tokenize_all's pool winner now judges **Verified** (tpr 0.000) where Phase 96 recorded Inconclusive — `verify_all` re-scores the template seed under the W8 recovery, its row now deciding on the propagated paths — while the selector gains no preference from it (the standing no-Verified-preference pin holds) and its executed agreement is unmoved at 0/8, so no pool crown changes hands. The harness's stale skip narration is fixed in all three places (the file header, the report intro, the verdict string): the spec states **four** postconditions since R1, and the secondary count is named as the original two rows' projection, with the strengthened rows Z3-judged through the composition candidates. The crowns are additionally pinned outside the ignored harness by a Z3-gated suite test (`phase97_composition_crowns`), so the standings ride the normal suites. **WS3 — GATE RE-RUN #3, clause by clause against the gate text exactly as written.** The reading, stated plainly (the Phase 88 precedent, extended by this phase's commission): "Z3 verified" is judged on the crowned winners — pool crowns where the pool crowns, composition crowns where WS2 crowned them; "100% golden test pass" on the crowned bodies' executed agreement against the golden batteries. > **Phase 99 (2026-11-22, branch `docs/f2-audit`) — F2 AUDIT + DESIGN: the smallest sound form of the Int→decimal conversion is measured and priced; the deliverable is [`F2_DESIGN.md`](F2_DESIGN.md). MEASUREMENT ONLY — no production code changed, no spec amended, the examples file untouched; the only code is five labeled scratch probes in the verifier's test module.** The owner commissioned F2 as a real language feature on 2026-11-22 ("tutup gerbang dengan memenuhinya"); this phase determines its form. **The payoff site is exactly one construction:** the shared `tokenize_step_body` builder (engine.rs:5456–5466 — the Phase 85 template seed and, since Phase 92, the resolver's `tokenize_one` denotation, one function) builds the constant `"Unexpected character"` where the mirror (tests/tokenizer_proof.rs:129) interpolates `format!("Unexpected character '{}' at line {}", other, state.line)` over the post-skip state; `tokenize_all` inherits through the STEP's propagated Err, and no other body or spec needs the conversion for the gate (the Codegen module's numeric-Display needs live in the M5 adapter's hand-written shims, outside M1). **Candidate forms, priced:** (a) a **builtin function call** in the Appendix A tradition — reuses `Expr::Call`/`IRNode::Call`, one `len`-shaped arm per layer (typechecker stdlib table, `eval_call`, `sym_call` + `encode_expr`, the `encodable.rs` mirror, `ir_call_text`; the parser, the statement judge, and C/Python/JS/WAT need nothing — the last four have no Call arm at all and inherit their standing catch-all stance), **S–M, and NO bootstrap cascade** (no kind table moves; the Codegen module stays at 129 specs; the artifact stands); (b) a D1a method — **gate-fatal by measurement**: `Expr::MethodCall` lowers to a Hole (engine.rs:7339–7349, pinned) and bodies are IR, so a method cannot reach the payoff site at any price short of a new IR kind; (c) a new unary IR node — **L**, the full Phase 78-style cascade for the identical encoding; (d) string interpolation — **L**, sugar over (a) plus a parser surface. **Semantics, probe-pinned:** the reference is Rust Display for i64 (probe table: 0, positives plain, negatives with `-`, both i64 extremes exact). SMT-LIB's `int.to.str` exists in the bundled solver and is Rust-exact on non-negatives, but **maps negatives to the empty string** (measured through `Solver::from_string`); its sign-split form expresses Rust exactly — yet the term is **unbuildable from the pinned z3 crate 0.20**: the safe API has no conversion constructor, z3-sys binds `Z3_mk_int_to_str` but the thread-local context's raw handle is `pub(crate)` in the z3 crate (the Phase 76 CharStr wall), and a direct z3-sys dependency does not unlock it. **The proposed arm is therefore literal fold + uninterpreted function**: a known i64 argument folds to the exact Rust string; a symbolic argument becomes a UF application (congruence free). Measured with the UF over a **free** line constant: `tokenize_one`'s real rows **Prove 1+2** at the faithful Err point `" 5"` (neither row reads the payload) and row 2 still **Refutes** the unlicensed Err at `"spec 5"` — so the STEP composition is expected to hold Verified, its body-level re-measurement being Phase 101's gate. The UF's cost is named: a payload-*reading* row is unprovable through it (provable under the fold), and a Refuted drawn through a UF term is untrustworthy — the build carries a refutation-degradation rule in the Phase 97 house style. **Scope: Int only** (Float is F3, separate and open; Char→String is already expressible via Append; Bool unneeded). **Build plan: Phase 100 the builtin end-to-end (S–M) → Phase 101 the template payoff + re-measurement (S; crowns 10/10 + 8/8, benchmark spot re-run, bundle re-measure) → Phase 102 gate re-run #4 (S, docs). Total ≈ M.** Four owner decisions are posed in the design doc (D1 form, D2 name — `int_to_str` recommended, D3 scope, D4 the encoder arm, with D4's decline-symbolic option recorded as gate-fatal). Suites: **542/0/30 default, 542/0/30 bootstrap-codegen, 417/0/22 no-Z3** (baselines 537/537/416; delta = exactly the +5 probes, four z3-gated and the Display-reference probe ungated, hence +1 in the no-Z3 configuration). > **Phase 105 (2026-11-22, master) — ROADMAP DECISION (docs only): the roadmap gains a new milestone, 1.1 — Embeddable Morphic, placed after 1.0.** The owner decided on 2026-11-22, ratifying Muse's proposal ("Jadikan 1.1 — milestone embed sendiri sesudah 1.0"): 1.1 stands as its own milestone with its own gate, sequenced after 1.0 — the recorded rationale is that the verified standard library (1.0) lands first because embedded functions need something to call; embedding without a stdlib would be thin. **Scope sketch, as proposed and accepted:** `morphic build` emits ready-to-import packages of synthesized, verified functions — an **npm package** (WASM/JS with TypeScript types) and a **Rust crate** — so the functions are imported and called like ordinary functions; **typed host bindings** marshal records/lists/strings automatically between JS/Python/Rust hosts and Morphic functions, so users never touch internal data formats; and **examples + "5-minute" documentation** show dropping a verified function into an existing web/app. The seeds are already in the tree: the JS/WASM codegen targets and the `crates/morphic-wasm/` crate from v0.6 — 1.1 packages that foundation into a product. **Status: TARGET only** — no gate is defined yet, no checkboxes exist to tick, no 1.0/1.1 work has started, and nothing is claimed as built; the details are undecided, at the owner's call. This phase changes docs only (the README roadmap row, this note, and a CHANGELOG [Unreleased] entry): no code, no version bump, no tag, no release.

> **Phase 106 (2026-11-22, branch `docs/stdlib-audit`) — 1.0 AUDIT: feasibility + scope for the production-ready verified standard library, measured in [`STDLIB_AUDIT.md`](STDLIB_AUDIT.md) (the Phase 72/90/99 lineage: measurement + design only, no production code changed, no spec amended; the only code is two named probe artifacts, `tests/phase106_probes.rs` + `tests/phase106_pipeline_probes.rs`).** **Headline verdict: 1.0 is achievable, but not as "Appendix A, implemented"** — the honest shape is a core library of ~25–30 entries (Int, Char, String basics, List per D7, Result/Option helpers) shipped as a **hybrid** (the two existing builtins + bundled `.morph` modules merged by the compiler as a prelude) and gated at the M1 standard. **The inventory finding:** of Appendix A's 20 names, exactly **2 are implemented** (`len`, `int_to_str`) — the other 18 typecheck with coarse types and no argument validation, then fail at every judge (probe: direct-call bodies not evaluable, Inconclusive); the template library is **3 structural templates + 13 constraint-seed families**, not the README's v0.4 "9 patterns"; the corpus is 156 specs / 301 in-spec tests with **no bundled library anywhere**; `import` is parsed and then ignored (probe: `check` accepts a module importing a nonexistent file — there is no module resolution in the pipeline); Option has **no eliminator at all** in spec expressions (probe: `x.unwrap()`/`x.is_some()` on `Option<Int>` are type errors naming the closed Result/List table). **Two NEW blockers, neither previously named:** (1) **the verifier never assumes `require:` preconditions** — a faithful hand-written `int_clamp` body executes 3/3 and is **VerificationFailed** on the precondition-violating counterexample `{x: 1, lo: 1, hi: 0}`; preconditions today reach only the LLM prompt; priced S–M to close, and it taxes every precondition-bearing entry (clamp, div, binary_search) until closed; (2) **Float literals are unparseable in spec source** (the parser has no FloatLit arm — a decimal literal is a parse error, probe-pinned), standing in front of the already-known Float walls (Float params bind Opaque — AST-attached `float_abs` executes 2/2, Inconclusive — and F3 formatting). **Family standings, measured:** Int READY (hand `int_abs` Verified; clamp blocked only by the precondition gap — the pipeline's 1/3 Inconclusive is a separate search gap); Char READY (pipeline `char_is_digit` **Verified** 3/3); String basics READY (pipeline `string_is_empty` **Verified** 2/2) with transforms killed by F5 exactly as scoped; Result READY at hand standard (Match body **Verified** 2/2; pipeline 1/2 is a seed gap, S–M); List executed-YES / symbolic-NO uniformly (compiled runner scores count_matching's and sort's template bodies 1.000; the interpreter declines For/Reverse/Map; the verifier binds List params as **length only**, so no element-level entry can Verify at any body quality — the list-element encoder is the audit's one XL blocker); higher-order entries blocked by G4 at test binding itself (lambda test inputs unbindable); is_sorted's pipeline crowns a constant-true 4/5 because its AdjacentScan body never reaches any judge (the §3.4 runner-trigger wall, S, owner-reserved); binary_search at pipeline tpr 0.000 (G5, scoped around). **Packaging:** route (a) bundled modules prices the missing loader (M) — or S–M as a compiler **prelude merge** at the SpecIndex construction point that already exists, which is the recommended hybrid's spine; route (b) all-builtins prices XL in aggregate by the Phase 102 precedent (one builtin = one cascade: +1 Codegen spec, +11 M3 cases, artifact regen); bundle headroom is **41,091 B** (729,981 vs 771,072 budget), so the gate draft carries a bundle clause. **The audit delivers:** the family feasibility table, 12 priced blockers, a 7-clause 1.0 gate draft in the M1 style (frozen scope / every entry checks / golden-exact / Verified-or-builtin-battery / cross-target honesty / budgets / Appendix A rewritten from "(Planned)" to per-entry reality — with a Tier-2 for List entries existing *only if* the owner creates it in D7), a phase plan 107–114 (≈ L on the two-tier branch, ≈ XL+ if the list encoder is closed first), and **eight owner decisions D1–D8** with recommendations (D1 core scope, D2 hybrid-prelude, D3 close the precondition gap first, D4 Float out, D5 F5 out, D6 G4 out — first post-1.0 build, D7 two-tier List gate, D8 Set/Map out). Suites on the branch: **573/0/30 default, 573/0/30 bootstrap-codegen, 444/0/22 no-Z3** — baselines 555/555/426 plus exactly the 18 probe tests, zero failures (the verdict-bearing probes cfg-gate their Z3 assertions per the Phase 99/100 precedent; pipeline probes assert completion only, the outcome line is the datum). No merge, no push — the branch awaits the owner's D1–D8 calls, which Phase 107 ratifies and freezes into a scope + gate document.

> **Phase 107 (2026-11-22, master) — NORTH STAR PINNED (docs only): Morphic's long-term ambition is to become as well-known as Python and relevant in everyday use, with the road deliberately running to the chaotic-good horizon.** The owner pinned this direction on 2026-11-22, in his words: "aku mau morphic seterkenal phyton dan relevan dalam penggunaan sehari hari" — reaching "sampe bisa di tingkat Horizon liar — chaotic-good". **Framing:** fame for a language is distribution plus one killer niche, not features alone; Morphic's wedge is the AI-agent era, where generated code is abundant and *proven-correct* code is the scarce thing. **The ladder:** (1) **Dipakai** — be used: 1.0's verified standard library, then 1.1's embeddable packages; (2) **Disebar** — be distributed: an MCP server, the WASM Component Model, a package registry, LSP/VS Code support, edge deployment, and proof-carrying code; (3) **Ikonik** — the wild horizon: smart-contract targets, GPU-scale synthesis, and more expressive specs that close F3/F5-class limits at the root. **Status: VISION, not a gate** — this note defines no gate, schedule, or claim for any rung; the measurable commitments remain 1.0, then 1.1, in that order, and no upper rung is scheduled or claimed as built. This phase changes docs only (this note, one README roadmap pointer, and a CHANGELOG [Unreleased] entry): no code, no version bump, no tag, no release.

> **Phase 109 (2026-11-22, branch `feat/stdlib-109-preconditions` from `feat/stdlib-108-scope` @ `2856522`) — §3.1 CLOSED (decision D3a, executed first as ratified): the verifier assumes `require:` preconditions.** Until this phase `verify_one` and the statement judge encoded postconditions over **all** inputs; `require:` rows reached only the LLM prompt, so a faithful body could be refuted at a point its own spec excludes (the audit's exhibit: faithful `int_clamp`, 3/3 executed, **VerificationFailed** at {x:1, lo:1, hi:0} under `require: lo <= hi`). **The mechanism** (production `src/verify/verifier.rs`): once per `verify_one`, the spec's precondition rows are encoded through the same route a postcondition takes — statement-bodied calls in a row resolve by the Phase 96 route, their facts folding into the assumption set — and the resulting terms are asserted as hypotheses on **every route that mints or denies a verdict**: the expression judge's row check and its Phase 97 per-disjunct (W8) fallback; the statement judge's per-path checks, its per-path fallback, and its exhaustion gate (exhaustion reachable only off-domain no longer blocks a proof); and, via a new `StmtCtx.assumptions` field seeding the root statement state's standing assumptions, the evaluation's solver-guided decisions and the Phase 96 invariant obligations (initiation/consecution/exit are discharged on the spec's domain — the counting-loop tooth's invariant row `i <= n` at entry IS its `require: n >= 0`). The Phase 100 D4a UF scan extends over the assumed terms, so a countermodel must be a countermodel on-domain under the real conversion. **The decline discipline (the phase's conservative choices, pinned by teeth):** a precondition row that cannot be encoded, OR a precondition set whose joint satisfiability under the Char side conditions is not DECIDEDLY Sat (Unsat = an empty domain, under which every postcondition is vacuously true for any body — a Verified would certify a broken spec, not an implementation; Unknown = the solver cannot rule an empty domain out), declines the **whole** verification: every row Unknown, the candidate Inconclusive — never silently assumed-true, and never dropped while judging proceeds unassumed (that would keep minting §3.1's false refutations for exactly the hardest-to-state contracts). The verdict taxonomy carries the decline without a new status: it is the standing Inconclusive, with the cause recorded here and in the code, the same honesty shape as the no-Z3 backend's labelled subset. **Executed judging gains the matching half:** a test point PROVEN to violate `require:` (a three-valued concrete evaluator in `eval.rs` decides the row false at the point; undecidable rows — quantified, predicate, method-call shapes — never silence) is **spec-silent**: a new `TestOutcome::SpecSilent` outcome (API string `spec_silent`), reported per test with its reason, excluded from the evaluable denominator and from `valued_test_count`, and the body is never evaluated there (a `b = 0` division point is silent, not a crash or a failure). Binding (`test_bindability`) is untouched — silence is a domain fact, not a representability fact. **The mirror:** `encodable.rs` is unchanged, by the Phase 94 reasoning — it mirrors the BODY evaluator (`sym_eval`), whose encodability precondition assumptions do not touch (a body's symbolic evaluation neither gains nor loses a value because its spec carries `require:` rows; the assumption machinery is constraint/session-side); its harvested-corpus cross-check test passes unmodified inside the green suites. **Verdict movements, all named:** exactly one standing verdict moved — the Phase 106 audit exhibit itself, flipped at its site in `tests/phase106_probes.rs` (faithful clamp: VerificationFailed → **Verified**, counterexample gone; the pre-fix measurement stands in STDLIB_AUDIT.md §3.1). Nothing else moved: the Phase 106 pipeline probe's clamp line is byte-identical in its summary fields (Inconclusive, tpr 0.333, interp 1/3/3 — the pipeline's clamp SEARCH gap is a separate fact, as the audit itself separated it; its winner is a junk Match body that proves nothing on any domain), and `binary_search`'s pipeline line is likewise unchanged (its `require: is_sorted(haystack, cmp)` is unencodable — a named Predicate over a function-typed parameter — so its candidates now decline whole to the same Inconclusive its unencodable bodies already produced; the Tier-2 battery discipline for it is Phase 113's, per the freeze). Every spec without `require:` rows takes the `None` disposition and asserts byte-for-byte the old sessions — pinned by a dedicated no-precondition test and by the unmoved suites. **Teeth** (`tests/phase109_preconditions.rs`, 9 tests, failing-first against the pre-fix tree): the clamp flip; a body wrong at a precondition-SATISFYING point still VerificationFailed, its countermodel on-domain (lo ≤ hi in the model); jointly unsatisfiable preconditions mint nothing for a faithful OR a garbage body; an unencodable precondition (Float parameter, Opaque-bound) declines whole; the statement/invariant route Verifies only under the assumption; the W8 per-disjunct fallback Proves only under the assumption; spec-silent points (clamp + division) with denominator and valued-count pins. **Suites: 582/0/30 default, 582/0/30 bootstrap-codegen, 453/0/22 no-Z3** — the Phase 106 baselines (573/573/444) + exactly the 9 new tests in every configuration. Code commit `cbf6a5a`; this note + the CHANGELOG entry are the docs commit. No gate text changed (STDLIB_SCOPE.md frozen); no other blocker touched (§3.4, the Option table, For loops keep their own phases: 113, 112, 113). Next: Phase 110, the packaging spine.
