> **Phase 57 (2026-11-21, branch `feat/generation-gap-audit`) — GENERATION-GAP AUDIT: why the opt-1 pools hold no correct body for the four standalone specs, what each candidate fix costs, and the campaign plan. Audit only — no production code changed; a temporary probe instrument (pool census + verdict distribution + rustc pool scan, 3 draws per spec through the real pipeline) was written, run, and removed, and its numbers are recorded here. Checkbox 3 stays open.**
> **(1) Generation inventory at opt 1 (code + probe).** The pipeline is `SynthesisEngine::run` (`src/synthesis/engine.rs:488`): seed → MCTS → GA (gated `opt_level >= 3`, engine.rs:520) → protected-seed readmission → scoring. `SynthesisConfig::from_opt_level` (engine.rs:413): opt 1 = population 20, 1,000 MCTS iterations, 5 s, `use_llm = false`; opt 2 = pop 50 / 5,000 iter / `use_llm = true`; opt 3 (the CLI default, `src/main.rs:44`, and the fallback for any other level) = pop 100 / 10,000 / `use_llm = true`; opt 4 = pop 500 / 100,000 / `use_llm = true`, min_score 0.9. `seed_population` (engine.rs:546) contributes, in order: ONE test-induced seed (a match over the test inputs with a typed wildcard hole, engine.rs:592ff); THREE template seeds whose builders are all bare `Hole`s (`build_divide_and_conquer` / `build_iterator_chain` / `build_simple_loop`, engine.rs:1893-1903 — the real template library in `src/synthesis/templates.rs` has NO production caller); constraint seeds (engine.rs:754ff); LLM seeds iff `use_llm`; then typed random bodies (`random_ir_tree_typed`, engine.rs:2271) filling to 20. The seed list is then sorted and passed through `dedup_by(ir_equivalent)` where `ir_equivalent` compares only the root variant's discriminant (engine.rs:1871) — measured consequence: the three identical template holes collapse to one, and every final pool below contains exactly ONE template candidate, always labelled divide_and_conquer. MCTS (engine.rs:869) runs two trees of 1,000 iterations — one rooted at a random pool member, one rooted at the test-induced seed — and harvests visited terminal nodes. GA/mutation/crossover contribute NOTHING at opt 1. Measured final pools (post-MCTS engine pool = the verify pool; 3 draws each): **sort 17/17/15** (distinct 14/14/12; per draw: random_seed 13/13/11, mcts_harvest 1, mcts_seed_harvest 1, TestInduced 1, Template 1); **binary_search 22/36/22** (distinct 22/36/22; random 12/14/12, mcts_harvest 4/16/4, mcts_seed_harvest 4, TestInduced 1, Template 1); **count_matching 21/20/22** (distinct 19/18/19; random 14/13/15, mcts_seed_harvest 4, mcts_harvest 1, TestInduced 1, Template 1); **is_sorted 22/19/17** (distinct 21/18/16; random 14/14/12, mcts_harvest 4/1/1, mcts_seed_harvest 2, TestInduced 1, Template 1). ConstraintInduced, Crossover, LLMGenerated: **0 in all 12 draws**. Opt ≥2 in the default build never reaches MCTS or GA at all: `seed_population` propagates `seed_from_llm`'s error (engine.rs:571) and `call_llm` errors "No LLM backend enabled" when neither `llm-local` nor `llm-remote` is compiled (Cargo.toml default features are z3-only; the llm-local arm is itself a stub error, and llm-remote posts to a localhost Ollama) — measured this phase: `synthesize(spec, 2)` and `synthesize(spec, 3)` both return `Err(LLM error: No LLM backend enabled)`. There is no opt ≥2 configuration that skips the LLM seed, so MCTS/GA cannot run LLM-free above opt 1 today.
> **(2) Why the pools miss — classification (a): the needed shapes are never proposed.** Shape census over all 231 distinct pool bodies from the probe (Debug-repr scan): **Index 0, Map 0, Filter 0, Fold 0, Sort 0, Lambda/Closure 0, Assign 0, Alloc 0, self-calls 0**. `Call` appears only in sort (2/draw) and binary_search (5/draw) bodies — the test-induced seed's converted expected outputs (`Some(..)`, list literals), never element access or recursion. For/While do appear in random bodies, but only as statement-position loops from `gen_typed_stmt` whose bodies are discarded expression statements — they cannot accumulate, index, or build output. The cause is the typed generator's documented menu (engine.rs:2231ff): fresh bodies are built only from literals, exactly-typed variables, BinOp/UnaryOp over scalar operands, literal collections, and If/Match/Let/Block/Return tails — no Call, no Index, no Len, no Concat, no higher-order nodes — because those shapes are what the Rust emitter and the conservative type verdict can stand behind. Per spec: **sort** — a correct body needs element permutation (recursion/iteration + construction, or the IR's own `Sort` node); pools contain identity (`list`), `vec![]`, and constant-conditional variants of both (Phase 56 crown files), which is exactly the menu's List repertoire for a generic element type. **count_matching** — a correct body must inspect elements (`Index`/iteration + comparison + counting); the menu offers only arithmetic over `threshold`, so crowns are constant-0 equivalents passing only the none-match test (1/3, Phase 53/56). **binary_search** — return type `Option<I64>` has NO typed literal menu (`typed_literal_fillings` returns None for Option), so roots fall to typed holes or legacy-menu fillings over the generic parameters (`needle + haystack`); crowns are verdict-Unknown, rustc-ill-typed. **is_sorted** — the menu cannot compare adjacent elements, so the best available body is constant `true`, which the test set rewards 4/5. Not (b): no correct-shaped body exists in any scanned pool to be scored away (Phase 53's compiled pool scans: 0 pass-all in 44 sort + 44 count_matching distinct bodies; this probe's census shows the shapes are absent, not outscored). Not (c): the IR vocabulary expresses all of it (`IRNode::Index/Fold/Sort/Call/Assign/Alloc/For`, engine.rs:122ff) — the generators' menus and the interpreter's subset exclude it, and the one library that contains the algorithms (`templates.rs`: divide-and-conquer sort, binary search, fold, linear scan) is uncalled and stale against current signatures (its sort recursion passes one argument to a two-parameter spec; its binary search returns a tuple-wrapped index and `Var("None")`).
> **(3) Constraint-seed applicability — no existing family admits any of the four, and for two of them no constraint family could.** The families rescue specs whose constraints ARE bodies: an `output == <expr>` equation, or Or-rows of scalar guard leaves + an output pin. Parsed postconditions (probe-printed): **sort** = `Predicate("is_permutation")`, a `Forall` over indices whose body calls the fn parameter as a predicate, `len(output) == len(list)` (an equation about lengths, not about `output`), and an `Implies` over `Predicate("is_sorted")` — no top-level `output ==` equation, no Or-rows. **count_matching** = a `Forall` one-way implication (`x > threshold` implies `output > 0`) + two bounds (`output >= 0`, `output <= len(list)`) — these constrain but do not determine a count; the counting construction appears nowhere in them. **binary_search** = a `Forall` over the output-as-index + an `Implies` into a `Forall`. **is_sorted** = an `Implies` + two `Forall`s over adjacent indices. Verdicts: sort and binary_search need an ALGORITHM (search/sort construction) — the honest seed source is the signature, not the constraints (template territory, item 2). is_sorted likewise (an adjacent-pair scan). count_matching is the one spec with a derivable construction: a future **forall-fold family** could mine the quantified predicate (`x > threshold`) from the `Forall` and build a fold/count body from it — a genuinely new family under the Phase 17/49 discipline, whose body (Fold node or loop+accumulator) would still sit outside the interpreter's evaluable subset and the typed generator's menu, so it must be judged by the compiled vehicle (item 5b) or not at all.
> **(4) Variation operators — five of six are empty, the sixth only deletes, and mutation is unreachable at opt 1 anyway.** `mutate` (engine.rs:1197) draws among six kinds: kind 0 `un_synthesize` is the only working one — and it is crude: `random_subtree` returns a clone of the WHOLE body (engine.rs:1861, "Simplified"), so the operator holes large structure rather than editing a chosen subtree. Kinds 1-5 — `inline_random_call`, `swap_equivalent`, `optimize_loop`, `add_parallel_hint`, `random_rewrite` — are empty function bodies (engine.rs:5368-5372, under the literal header "Stub helpers"). `mutate` and `crossover` are called only from `genetic_refine` (engine.rs:1119/1152), which `run` invokes only at opt ≥3 — a configuration the default build cannot reach (item 1). So the `Mutation` provenance in opt-1 pools is random seeds and MCTS harvest labels, never `mutate`. Even implemented, the stubs are local perturbations: no local rewrite of `list`, `true`, or `0` invents element iteration with accumulation. Mutation pays off only AFTER structural bodies exist to mutate from; it is not a prerequisite for closing the gap.
> **(5) Fn-typed evaluation — three options, measured.** Today (option c, status quo): sort's and binary_search's tests never bind (`bind_test_env` excludes any tuple element `value_of_expr` cannot map; a lambda lowers through `expr_to_ir` to a Hole), so `evaluate_candidate` (engine.rs:5169) scores every hole-free body by the FALLBACK tpr 1.0, and ranking among crowns falls to the complexity/quality tie-breakers. The verifier adds nothing for sort: probe verdicts over 3 draws were **Inconclusive for every hole-free candidate and Malformed for the 2 holed seeds, 0 Verified, 0 VerificationFailed**, with `constraint_score` overwritten by `verify_all` to **0.000 for every candidate** — all four postconditions come back Unknown (Forall/Predicate have no encoding, verifier.rs:883-887; even `len(output) == len(list)` is unencodable because list parameters are symbolic-opaque to the encoder). For count_matching the verifier CAN refute (1-7 VerificationFailed per draw, via the list-free bounds) and is_sorted's crowns are honestly measured by tests (tpr 0.800) — the blind spot is exactly the fn-typed pair. **(a) Function values in the interpreter (M):** add a `Value::Function` variant (params + body + captured env) — `Value` is `#[derive(PartialEq)]` over plain data (eval.rs:28) while `IRNode` has no `PartialEq`, so the derive breaks and equality must be hand-written (the Debug-fingerprint precedent in `readmit_protected_seeds`) or functions must compare never-equal; `value_of_expr`/`expr_to_ir` must learn to lower a Lambda to a closure value (today it becomes a Hole); `eval_flow`'s Lambda/Closure arms (currently NotEvaluable) must return the closure, and `eval_call` must apply a callee resolved from the environment, not only the `List`/`len` builtins. Other `Value` consumers are safe (m3_gate's matches carry catch-alls). Unlock: sort/binary_search tests bind and expression-subset bodies score truthfully everywhere including the MCTS reward. Limit, stated plainly: bodies using loops, Assign/Alloc, or Map/Filter/Fold/Sort nodes remain NotEvaluable and would score 0 — so (a) alone would rank the identity body (evaluable, 3/6) ABOVE a correct loop-based sort (unevaluable, 0/6); it must pair with subset expansion or with (b). **(b) Compiled-runner scoring at the final stage (M):** the Phase 53 instrument's vehicle, productized — after MCTS, render each finalist, compile function + a runner generated from the spec's tests, execute, and overwrite tpr before selection (the `verify_all` rescoring precedent). Checkbox 3 stays open — G2 connects real algorithm bodies to the pool for all three target specs, but each spec's crown is now blocked by a DIFFERENT, precisely located wall (below); none of the three walls is a seeding failure.** **What was there (Phase 57 answer 1, verified):** the engine's three template builders returned bare `Hole`s, `templates.rs` (v0.4) had no production caller and its shapes were stale (a divide-and-conquer passing 1 argument to a 2-param spec, a binary search returning a tuple-wrapped index, pseudo-calls — "first"/"rest"/"concat"/"transform"/"push"/"combine" — that render as undefined free functions, two-pointer detection keyed on the spec NAME). **Support matrix (measured first, temporary probe, hand-built bodies judged by every vehicle):** the IR **Sort** node renders `{ let mut sorted = list; sorted.sort_by(cmp); sorted }` but rustc rejects it **E0631** against the generated signature `cmp: fn(T, T) -> bool` — `sort_by` wants `FnMut(&T, &T) -> Ordering`; an adapter lambda fails **E0507** (the comparator is applied to values behind shared references), a clone-adapter fails **E0308**, and `std::cmp::Ordering` values are **unconstructible** in the rendered vocabulary (`rust_ident` sanitizes `::`/`.` to `_`, and generated signatures carry no trait bounds). A filter-quicksort Sort variant is worse (E0308 + E0277: `.iter().filter(..).collect()` yields `Vec<&T>`). **Index/For/Alloc/Assign bodies** (the scan forms) render compilable Rust and typecheck (selector verdict Matches); the **interpreter** evaluates Index/BinOp/If/Let/Match but **not** While/For/Loop/Alloc/Assign/Lambda/Map/Filter/Fold/Sort (NotEvaluable) and rejects spec/self calls; **Z3** encodes none of the HOF/loop/mutation nodes (Inconclusive for every template body — neutral, never a refutation); the selector's `infer_ir_type` returns None for HOF/loop nodes → verdict **Unknown** (neutral, not Mismatched). **Fold** renders but its closure binds `&i64` where the IR body uses the element by value → **E0308** (the IR has no Deref node). **Option does not block**: `Call("Some",[x])` renders `Some(x)` and `Var("None")` renders `None`. **Index typing does**: a computed index is `i64` and cannot index a Vec (only `usize`; the spec language has no usize type — For-loop variables over `0..len` infer usize and work, which is why the scan forms compile and the binary-search loop does not). **The library** (`src/synthesis/templates.rs`, rewritten): `TemplateKind::{SortPrimitive, AdjacentScan, BinarySearch}`, instantiated from the spec's actual parameter names/types with collision-safe local names; a template that cannot instantiate cleanly does not fire. **Keying rule (structural only, NEVER spec names — recorded per the campaign approval):** sort-primitive fires iff return type is `List<E>` ∧ some param is `List<E>` (same E) ∧ some param is `Function([E, E], Bool)`; binary-search iff return is `Option(_)` ∧ params[0] is `List<E>` ∧ params[1] == E ∧ some param is `Function([E, E], Int)`; adjacent-scan iff exactly one param, `List<E>` with E a concrete ordered scalar (Int/I8–I64/U8–U64/Float/Char/String — Bool, Generic and Named excluded) ∧ return Bool. At most one template per spec. **Corpus inventory (142 specs, 8 files): the firing set is exactly {sort → SortPrimitive, binary_search → BinarySearch, is_sorted → AdjacentScan}** (asserted in the instrument) — no M2/M3/tokenizer/example spec fires. The three bare-Hole engine builders and `has_list_type` are deleted; `seed_from_templates` consumes the library.

The body is hole-free and typechecks against the spec's signature (selector verdict not Mismatched). One parser fact shaped the mining: `len(list)` in a postcondition parses as a Call, and the bounds postconditions (`output >= 0`, `output <= len(list)`) are not used by the family at all — the construction comes from the Forall alone, exactly as the Phase 57 audit said the stated constraints (one-way implication + bounds) do not determine a count but the quantified predicate does. **Judging — option (a) measured dead, option (b) landed.** The seed's interpreter tpr is 0.000 by construction (the interpreter evaluates no loop bodies; count_matching's tests bind, evaluable 3, passed 0 — while constant-0 holds a measured 0.333), and the verifier says nothing: the scan body verifies **Inconclusive, constraint_score 0.000** (measured) — option (a) is dead, as the brief predicted. Triggering seeds are **guaranteed finalist slots** (`choose_finalists` gains a guaranteed set: a guaranteed seed displaces the lowest-ranked unprotected finalist, never the would-be winner, never another guaranteed seed). **Scope, recorded as a decision:** the arm covers constraint-seed provenance ONLY. The provenance set is a named constant in the trigger; admitting Template later is a one-line change when the owner decides. The is_sorted control (instrument Part C) pins the exclusion: stage NotTriggered, crowns unchanged in character (Mutation, tpr 0.800, compiled 4/5).

> **Phase 127 (2026-11-23, branch `docs/g4-127-audit` from master @ `4881c1d`) — G4 SCOPE AUDIT: function values, the first post-1.0 language build (stdlib D6a), measured in [`G4_AUDIT.md`](G4_AUDIT.md) (the Phase 106/118 lineage: probes + design only, no feature code, no verdict changes; the probe artifact `tests/phase127_g4_probes.rs`, 12 probes, committed ahead of the documents).** **Headline: G4 is one build, not a staged pair — but the wall is not where STDLIB_AUDIT §2.7 recorded it, and two of its five layers are already standing.** The audit's price (interpreter L + encoder L) splits differently under measurement. **The wall sits one layer earlier than recorded — in the checker:** applying a function-typed parameter in an expression position is a *type error* today (`check: In spec 'apply_twice': postcondition: Called undefined function: 'f'` — `check_expr`'s Call arm resolves callees against module signatures, the `int_to_str` case and the stdlib fiction table, never against parameter variables), so a spec cannot even *state* `output == f(f(x))`; the admission taxonomy is measured across five shapes (postcondition/forall/require applications all Err; passing a fn parameter as an argument Ok via the fiction table; a bare-atom row Ok vacuously — the parser lowers it to a `Predicate`, whose checker arm never resolves the name). The fix is S and is the build's precondition. **The interpreter L stands as the centre** (no function variant in `Value`; lambda test rows Unbindable with the reason naming the gap verbatim; Lambda/Closure/Map/Filter/Fold/Sort decline by name in eval; bindable counts: the probe spec 0/2, sort 0/6, binary_search 0/7). **The Phase 95 residual is scoped precisely and is NOT G4:** raw-pool tpr 0.000 is about *named sibling calls* in context-free pool judging (raw eval takes no `SpecIndex` by signature) — adjacent symptom, disjoint cause; closing G4 does not move that number and the audit books no payoff there. **The compiled runner already judges function values end to end** — an apply body against lambda tests Scored 2/2, sort's SortPrimitive template Scored 6/6, and the seeded pipeline (seed 42) **crowns sort today at tpr 1.0** through it (the Phase 61 Clone-bound wall does not bite inside the runner's concretized harness; it bites only the generic `morphic build` signature, which stays owner-reserved and untouched by G4); **binary_search's crown sits at tpr 0.0** — the runner judged its template and its compiled form failed (G5's i64 index wall, Scored 0/7), so G4's in-process rescue is exactly what bypasses it. In the no-runner (browser) configuration both crowns read a *vacuous* 1.0 — the engine's scoring fallback assigns 1.0 when a spec has tests but zero evaluable ("tests assumed passed"); the same number, two epistemic standings, and the hole G4 closes. **The verifier:** fn parameters bind `Sym::Opaque`; apply bodies are unencodable → Inconclusive; an unused fn parameter does not poison (a spec ignoring its `f` Verifies today); fn equality checks and verifies Inconclusive, and `values_equal`'s derived-`==` fallback means equality must be *decided* (D5), not inherited. **The encoder L does not survive contact:** the only slice that means anything without §3.9's element model is an uninterpreted-function arm for direct application (S–M); the Map/Filter/Fold node encodings the audit priced are vacuous without elements and are re-filed to the §3.9 campaign. **Emitters:** Rust is complete today (an apply body renders `pub fn apply_render(f: fn(i64) -> i64, x: i64) -> i64 { f(f(x)) }`, generated tests pass closures); JavaScript accepts the parameter and renders the body `return undefined`; C types the parameter `void*` with the body commented out; Python passes; WASM renders its standing shell (the JS/C standings are NF-116-1-class, named, not inherited silently). **The payoff table, measured:** `map`/`filter`/`fold`/`all`/`any` ship in the 1.2 amendment at Tier-2 once G4 lands; **`range` is not a G4 item** — a hand body in the shipped vocabulary judges 2/2 in-process today, it needs only a scope amendment; **`zip` is not a G4 item** — its wall is the missing tuple *value* (a zip test's expected output maps to no interpreter value), a data-side decision of its own; **`is_permutation` is not a G4 item** — Predicate form (§3.10) + §3.9 elements. **Bootstrap cascade: zero for the core build, measured** — the self-host corpus's higher-order equations (`rust_expr_lambda_text`, `rust_filter_text`, `rust_fold_text`) mirror *renderings*, and G4 core changes no rendering; the tripwires (`ty_to_rust`'s Function arm, the Sort signature) are named non-goals for the Phase 128 freeze. **Eight decisions with recommendations** (D1 closures with by-value capture — named-references-only is measured insufficient, since the recorded wall is lambda-shaped · D2 capture-by-value snapshot, no self-capture for Let-bound functions · D3 checker admission with the standing coarse discipline · D4 named-reference supply included, staged after closures · D5 no equality on function values · D6 the UF arm included as its own phase · D7 no seed family — hand bodies per the D7a precedent · D8 **milestone shape: 1.2 = the G4 language build + the higher-order library amendment**, two freezes, one gate). **Phase plan 128–136:** ratification + `G4_SCOPE.md` freeze · checker admission · interpreter function values (the L core) · HO node judging (sort 6/6, binary_search 7/7 in-process) · named-reference supply · encoder UF arm · 1.2 amendment freeze (the five HO entries + `range` at Tier-2; `zip`/`is_permutation` excluded with their measured reasons) · amendment build (entries + JS HO arms for the npm surface) · 1.2 gate + merge + v1.2.0. The gate sketch's closing line: *"1.2 closes when a Morphic spec can take a function, apply it, and be judged for it by the interpreter that ships — and when the five higher-order entries and `range` stand at their named tiers on the final tree, with `sort` and `binary_search` crowned by that interpreter rather than rescued by a compiler."* Interactions named: §3.9 (not needed by G4; its payoff grows — elements + functions together make the five entries Tier-1 candidates); the quantified-mod campaign (independent, disjoint layers, either order); the embed packages (function types stay unmapped in EMBED_SCOPE §3 for this build — the unlock is a later amendment's, priced S–M atop G4; 1.2's npm work is only the emitter arms the amendment's own entries need). **Suites: 740/0/30, 740/0/30, 522/0/22 — each exactly +12 probes over the locally re-measured pristine-master baselines (728/0/30, 728/0/30, 510/0/22).** One record-keeping discrepancy, stated in the open: the Phase 126 record gives the third configuration as 594/0/22; that figure does not reproduce in this environment with the documented invocation (pristine master @ `4881c1d` measures 510/0/22, failed/ignored identical), so this note reports measured numbers; a re-baseline of the recorded figure is Phase 128 housekeeping. > **Phase 129 (2026-11-23, branch `feat/g4-129-checker` from `feat/g4-128-scope` @ `239aed1`) — CHECKER ADMISSION (D3a, G4_SCOPE §2.4): applying a function-typed parameter is admitted; the G4 build's precondition lands.** Code commit `f179f4f`. **The mechanism, in one arm:** `check_expr`'s Call arm resolves a callee in its standing order — the parser's constructors, module signatures, the `int_to_str` special case (its strict validation untouched, still earlier in the arm), the stdlib fiction table — and now, when none of those resolves the name, **falls back to the variable environment** before the standing error: a callee whose declared type is `TypeRef::Function` is admitted, and the application's type is that function type's own return, so nested application (`f(f(x))`) falls out of the same arm. The discipline is the checker's standing coarse one (D3a): arguments are checked as expressions, exactly as the module-signature arm treats them — no arity or per-argument validation was added, and the `int_to_str` precedent's strictness stays a builtin's exception, not a class. **The three Err shapes of the Phase 127 taxonomy check end to end** — `apply_twice` (the frozen §3 specimen, postcondition), `apply_fa` (application under a `forall` row), `apply_req` (application in a `require:` row) — their Err pins flipped to Ok pins at their sites in `tests/phase127_g4_probes.rs` (the end-to-end probe and the admission-taxonomy probe; both failed at the new asserts before the fix, the failing-first record), with the shapes re-pinned in the new `tests/phase129_checker.rs` (7 tests). **The exit condition is measured, not asserted: no other check outcome moves.** The before/after instrument ran `typeck::check` over every `.morph` file in the standing on-disk corpus — examples, the self-host specs, the stdlib, the playground examples + corpus, held_out: **24 files, and the diff is empty** (22 CHECK_OK; the two non-Ok rows are the playground's intentional negative fixtures — `invalid-syntax.morph`'s parse error and `invalid-type.morph`'s `++` error — byte-identical before and after). The table is now pinned in the phase's corpus test, file set included, so a future movement is a test failure, not a surprise. The wider net — the hundreds of inline spec sources the suites check — is the suite run itself, green below with only the phase's own teeth added. **The named non-movers, verified explicitly:** `pass_f` stands Ok through the fiction table, untouched; `apply_atom` still lowers to `Constraint::Predicate` and checks — the §2.4 bare-atom side door stands exactly as frozen, neither widened nor closed (§3.10's conversation); `same_f` stays checkable (its Inconclusive verdict is the verifier's standing, not the checker's); `ignore_f` checks and **still Verifies** — the §2.7 no-poisoning pin holds at this layer too. **The fallback's own discipline is pinned from the other side:** an Int variable used as a callee keeps the standing `Called undefined function: 'x'` error, a genuinely unknown name keeps the standing diagnostic (the phase110/typeck pins stand), and the admitted application provably yields the declared return type — the `++` discriminator: a String-returning parameter composes with a string literal, an Int-returning one does not (a placeholder return type would have passed both). **One boundary, recorded as a decision:** the fallback matches the declared `TypeRef::Function` directly — the checker's variable environment holds declared types unexpanded, as its Var arm reads them — so a parameter declared through a type *alias* to a function type is not admitted by this arm and keeps the standing error; the freeze's corpus carries no such exhibit, and admitting it later is a one-line `expand_aliases` at this same site, not a redesign. Suites, run solo in sequence under the §9 invocations: **747/0/30, 747/0/30, 613/0/22** — the §9 baselines (740/740/606) + exactly the 7 new teeth in every configuration; no flake this phase. G4_SCOPE.md / G4_AUDIT.md untouched. Next: Phase 130 (interpreter function values, D1a/D2a/D5a — the L core).

> **Phase 130 (2026-11-23, branch `feat/g4-130-interpreter` from `feat/g4-129-checker` @ `5c7a9a6`) — INTERPRETER FUNCTION VALUES (D1a/D2a/D5a, G4_SCOPE §2): the G4 build's L core lands — closures evaluate, bind, and are judged in-process.** Code commit `721f4f8`. **The value model (§2.1):** `Value` gains exactly one function variant, `Function { params: Vec<String>, body: Box<IRNode>, env: Env }`. `IRNode::Lambda` evaluates to a closure capturing a **by-value snapshot of the whole environment at creation** (a later rebinding of a captured name does not leak in — pinned); `IRNode::Closure` captures **by name** — exactly the listed bindings resolved against the enclosing environment, an unbound capture name declining by name. Application (a new fallthrough in `eval_call`, the builtin arms keeping precedence) binds parameters over the captured environment — **parameters shadow captures** — while a name bound to a non-function value and an arity mismatch decline by name, and an unbound callee keeps the standing `call to unknown function` decline verbatim. **No self-capture (D2a) is pinned:** a Let-bound function's body calling its own name declines `unknown function` — the binding does not exist yet at capture time, and no fixpoint syntax was added; recursion remains a named-spec feature. **Binding (§2.5):** `value_of_expr` gains a Lambda carve-out parallel to Phase 75's MethodCall one (a lambda maps to a closure whose body is lowered once through `expr_to_ir`, captured env empty), so lambda test rows bind and the audit's `Unbindable` outcome — whose reason named this gap verbatim ("e.g. a function/lambda") — **ends for lambda rows**; the reason now names the remaining classes ("a tuple or a named function reference"). **`apply_twice` judges 2/2 in-process** (bindable 2/2, outcomes [Passed, Passed]) — the phase's frozen exit standing — `apply_once` judges likewise, and a `require:` row deciding through application lands SpecSilent/Passed through Phase 109's machinery. **Budget discipline (§2.3), in two halves:** application spends the **standing shared budget** (`MAX_LOOP_ITERATIONS` = 10,000 — the same counter loop iterations spend; a Block of 10,001 sequential applications declines `function application bound exceeded`); and nesting is bounded separately at **`MAX_APPLICATION_DEPTH = 10`**, a bound the phase measured rather than assumed: in this debug build the application chain costs tens of KB of host stack per live level, and a fat self-application body ran at 28 nested applications and **overflowed the stack at 32** on the test harness's 2 MB threads (a plain-recursion control survived ~1,000; `ulimit -s` 8192 KB) — the omega bomb and a growing self-application both decline `function application depth bound exceeded` instead of hanging or crashing, and sequential applications nest one deep, bounded by the step counter alone. **Equality decided, not inherited (D5a):** before this phase no function value existed, so the derived-`==` fallback under `values_equal` was latent — a naive variant addition would have inherited syntactic body+environment equality. Now `values_equal` returns `Option<bool>` and **declines (None) whenever either side contains a function value**, and `Value`'s `PartialEq` is manual with a closure never equal, so the fallback can never see one. Eq/Neq over closures declines `NotEvaluable` naming the §2.6 rule; a test whose expected output is itself a lambda declines the comparison (`BodyNotEvaluable`) — the D5a trap pinned; `same_f` stays checkable + Inconclusive, `ignore_f` still Verifies, and **the verifier is untouched** (fn params still bind Opaque; the UF arm is Phase 133). **Compiled-route agreement:** the in-process judge now reproduces the compiled runner's pinned apply standing (2/2 on the shared points); the runner stage itself no longer fires for these specs — its premise, unbindable tests, is gone (outcome NotTriggered, pool untouched) — and the **pipeline crowns flipped honestly**: sort's crown dropped from the runner-rescued 1.0 to an in-process **0.5** (its template ties a trivial return-the-input body at 3/6 and selection takes the trivial one — the crown is lower because the measurement is real), binary_search's rose from the G5 compilation verdict 0.0 to its true in-process **1/7**; both re-pinned at the probe with the story recorded. The binary_search pipeline now takes minutes (non-progressing candidate loops burn the full budget per test — the real cost of real judging). **Bundled standings, as measured (not required to move at 130):** sort binds 6/6 and its template judges (6 evaluable, 3 passed) — the three swap-needing tests decline on the template's Assign-to-Index swap, which the interpreter's Var-only Assign refuses by name; binary_search binds 7/7 and its template judges (7, 1) — "find in middle" passes on the first probe; five cases exhaust the shared budget because the template's progress Assigns sit inside a Let body and **the interpreter's Let evaluates its body in a cloned environment, discarding the Assigns** (a pre-existing statement-subset divergence from the compiled runner, isolated and proven in-phase with a minimal Let/Assign probe — NOT a function-value gap, and deliberately not fixed here: Phase 95/115 standings are built on the standing Let semantics); "empty list" declines on the template's bare `Var("None")` return, a constructor name with no in-process binding. **What stays declined for Phase 131, by name:** the Map/Filter/Fold/Sort IR node arms (still `NotEvaluable` by name), the Assign-to-Index boundary, the Let-clone loop-progress divergence, and the bare-constructor-Var idiom — 131 owns the frozen 6/6 and 7/7. **Fixture re-basings, all at their sites with the reason recorded:** five Phase 127 probe tests, four eval unit pins, the engine FALLBACK fixture and the runner trigger fixture (both re-based onto a nested-tuple input — the remaining Unbindable class — keeping their original purposes), and the W3 gate pins (the api.rs harness pin 0/0/6 → 3/6/6; `playground/corpus/cases.json` re-measured natively first per the gate's own protocol — new sort crown hash `09600bfa…`, outcomes passed×3/failed×3, the two W2 bindability cases flipped to `minBindable` 6 and 7). **Flagged, not touched:** three ignored instruments are premised on the pre-130 world and are Phase 131 re-basing material — the runner's ignored `runner_scoring_end_to_end` (asserts MINI_SORT bindable == 0), the ignored `src/phase53_measurement.rs` (sort winners' evaluable == 0), and `src/phase59_measurement.rs`. Phase 95/115 standings unmoved (their batteries are suite tests, green). Suites, run solo in sequence under the §9 invocations: **761/0/30, 761/0/30, 627/0/22** — the Phase 129 baselines (747/747/613) + exactly the 14 new teeth in every configuration; no flake this phase (one no-Z3 run was interrupted by a runtime restart and re-run in full; that configuration now takes ~23 min wall, the binary_search pipelines' real judging being the cost). > **Phase 131 (2026-11-23, branch `feat/g4-131-ho-judging` from `feat/g4-130-interpreter` @ `1a58506`) — HIGHER-ORDER JUDGING IN-PROCESS: the frozen standings land — sort 6/6 and binary_search 7/7 in-process at 100%, crowned by the shipped interpreter.** Code commit `99f7187`. **The four items, in the order the brief named them. (1) The HO arms:** Map/Filter/Fold/Sort evaluate in `eval_flow`, applying their function argument — a Lambda/Closure node, or any expression evaluating to a bound function value — through Phase 130's closure machinery (`apply_value` → `apply_closure`), so every application spends the shared budget and nests under the depth bound exactly as a Call through a bound name does. Semantics are the compiled forms': Map applies per element in order; Filter keeps the elements its predicate answers `true` for (a non-Bool answer declines by name — truthiness is never guessed); Fold is the left fold from its initial value, in element order; Sort is a **stable** merge sort under the spec-level comparator meaning (cmp(a, b) true ⟺ a strictly precedes b; a pair the comparator cannot separate in either direction keeps its input order, as the compiled `sort_by` is stable — the compiled `sort_by(cmp)` form itself does not typecheck against the generated signature, the recorded E0631 wall, so the spec's stated ordering is the semantics, not a literal rendering). A non-function function-position, a non-List collection, and a non-Bool comparator answer each decline by name. **(2) Assign-to-Index:** the Assign arm gains indexed places — `xs[i] = v` mutates the bound list in place, places nest (`grid[i][j] = v`), the value evaluates first in the standing order, and the failure shapes are the read side's (`eval_index`): unbound root, non-list base or element, negative index, out-of-bounds index — each named, never a panic, never a silent grow; a target that is neither a variable nor an indexed place keeps a named decline. **(3) The Let delta — the delicate item, mapped before it was touched.** The dependency map: the compiled emitter renders a Let's body as the continuation of the same scope (`let name = value;` then the body), so compiled semantics are *mutations persist, bindings scoped*; the interpreter's clone gave *both* to the clone. The exhibits split the difference exactly: sort's swap needs an Assign-to-Index **inside** a Let body; binary_search's progress needs Assigns to Alloc'd **outer** variables inside a Let body; nothing in either exhibit needs a Let-created binding to outlive the Let. Phase 95's statement bodies and Phase 115's hand bodies were built on the clone — what they depend on is the *binding* discipline (a Let's name, and anything Alloc'd inside its body, must not leak), which the map showed is separable from the *mutation* discipline. The change is therefore the smallest delta that reaches the compiled semantics: **the body evaluates in the current environment; on exit — value, Return, Break, or failure — the Let's own binding is restored to its pre-Let state and every name the body created is removed.** Net delta vs the clone: mutations to pre-existing bindings persist (Assign rebinds and statement-position Append on outer variables — precisely "a Let body's Assigns take effect"); binding visibility is identical to the clone's everywhere. The one deliberate divergence from the compiled text: the Let's *own* name, if the body rebinds it, is restored rather than carried (a statement-position Let is not the tail; the clone's scoping of the name itself was never the divergence being closed). Match arms keep their clone — neither exhibit needs them and they were not in the brief. The discipline is pinned from both sides: a binding-scoping test written against the clone **passed before the change and passes after** (the non-mover pin), and the mutation tests fail before and pass after. **The STOP RULE never engaged:** no protected standing moved (below). **(4) The bare-constructor idiom:** an unbound `Var("None")` reads as `Value::None` — the compiled route renders the bare name as the variant itself (the binary_search template's final return is the exhibit, and a grep over body-building code confirms `None` is the only bare constructor Var produced); a real binding of the name wins (the env lookup runs first), and the unary constructors keep their Call form only — a bare `Var("Some")` still declines unbound, the boundary pinned. **The exhibits at their standings:** sort template (6 evaluable, 6 passed), binary_search template (7, 7) — both all-Passed outcome vectors, the binary_search judging completing in milliseconds against the template's previous budget exhaustion. **Pipeline crowns, re-measured (seed 42, the Phase 127 probe):** both specs now crown **the templates themselves at tpr 1.0** (winner_tests 6/6 and 7/7) — the gate's closing image, crowned by the interpreter rather than rescued by a compiler. The binary_search pipeline's wall time collapses with its loops progressing: **773.3 s → 1.7 s** (sort 0.63 s → 0.68 s); the crown probe's total run falls from 773.9 s to 2.4 s. **§3's other assignment — `apply_render`'s compiled standing, re-measured:** the G1 stage cannot be driven against that spec without fabricating the trigger premise this campaign removed, so the body's compiled verdict is measured through the compiled vehicle (the Phase 53 pattern): codegen + rustc + a hand main over the spec's own two tests → **Scored 2/2, unregressed** (the generated signature is the Phase 127 pin verbatim; in-process stands 2/2 in every configuration). The compiled route was not taxed by G4; only its invocation premise moved, by design. **The three flagged instruments, dispositioned — plus one the Fold arm reached first:** the runner's `scan_body` fixture had been re-based onto a Fold ingredient precisely because Fold was unevaluable; the Fold arm retired that premise inside the *non-ignored* trigger tests, so the fixture rotates its ingredient again, by its own documented pattern — now a Head/Tail Tail-chop scan (Head/Tail remain outside the subset, the Phase 95 residual; their compiled renderings are the standard ones and the Phase 60 end-to-end re-verified the stage scoring it 3/3 and crowning it). `runner_scoring_end_to_end`: its premise (a spec whose tests the interpreter cannot bind but the compiled harness can score) **no longer exists** — lambda tests bind since Phase 130, and the remaining unbindable class (nested-tuple inputs) is one the compiled harness cannot render either (the Phase 53 blocker-2 record) — so the test is re-based to pin the question where it now lives (MINI_SORT binds 3/3; the interpreter measures identity 2/3 and constant-empty 1/3 itself; the stage returns the pool untouched; selection crowns the identity) and **un-ignored**; the stage's compiled end-to-end coverage lives on in the Phase 60 instrument. `phase53_measurement`: re-based — the sort invariant flips from evaluable == 0 to **bindable == 6**, each winner's in-process run recorded, the compiled vehicle kept as cross-check; measured: count_matching crowns 6/6 draws at (3, 3) on both judges, **sort crowns the template itself 12/12 draws at tpr 1.000, interpreter (6, 6), compiled (6, 6)**. `phase59_measurement`: re-based — Part A stands verbatim (firing set exactly the three, 156 specs); > **Phase 132 (2026-11-23, branch `feat/g4-132-named-supply` from `feat/g4-131-ho-judging` @ `8f4df2e`) — NAMED-REFERENCE FUNCTION SUPPLY (D4a, G4_SCOPE §2.5/§3): the second supply form lands — a test row can supply a function by naming a spec in scope, and the frozen `double_it`/`apply_named` exhibits bind + judge in-process.** Code commit `8a5648a`. **The surface form is the bare name** — the shape the codebase already leaned toward, chosen on that evidence and recorded here: a tuple element (or a lone input) written as a plain name is `Expr::Var`, the checker's Var arm has resolved it to the Function type since before the audit, `bind_test_env`'s doc named it as this phase's form, and the Phase 127 probe measured it; no syntax is added. **Where resolution happens:** the interpreter's binding layer (`src/synthesis/eval.rs`) gains index-carrying variants of the whole judging family — `value_of_expr_in`, `test_outcomes_in`, `run_spec_tests_in`, `valued_test_count_in`, `bindable_test_count_in`, `test_bindability_in` — each taking the `SpecIndex` the prelude merge lives in; the context-free functions keep their exact behavior (they run the same code with no index in hand). The pipeline's own judging sites (engine scoring, the runner trigger, the API report, the package crown check) keep the context-free route in this phase — named supply is live wherever a consumer judges with a module index in hand, and the Phase 135 amendment wires the sites it needs with its own non-mover measurements. **The construction** (`named_function_value`): the name resolves via `SpecIndex::get` — so the collision rule is the index's own (Phase 110: the module's definition wins; pinned both ways — a prelude `int_abs` supplies and applies where the module defines none, and a module shadowing `int_abs` with the identity is what the name denotes there, distinguishable by the judged value) — and the closure is built from `SpecIndex::callee_body`'s denotation. An acyclic body is call-resolved by substitution (`inline_calls`, the standing consumer route) and captures nothing; a body calling siblings composes (the `quad_it` exhibit, `double_it ∘ double_it`, judges Passed). A **self-recursive** body keeps its raw denoted form over a **ladder of `MAX_APPLICATION_DEPTH + 1` closure generations**, each generation's captured environment binding the spec's own name to the previous generation (siblings bound as named values alongside): the ladder's foot is unreachable by construction — an application chain that deep has already declined by the depth bound — so recursion spends the standing budget/depth exactly as §2.3 froze, and a cycle back through a sibling (mutual recursion) declines the supply by name, §2.2's not-a-G4-form ruling. **The position discipline lives in `bind_part`:** a bare name binds only in a function position, only with an index in hand, and only when the named signature fits — exact arity; type components equal, except a generic component on either side fits anything (the checker's coarse discipline). **The four measured answers, pinned in `tests/phase132_named_supply.rs` (8 tests):** (a) the surface form above; (b) recursion — the guard-row `sum_to` exhibit judges Passed at 0, 5 and 9 (ten nested applications at the edge), `sum_to(10)` (eleven) declines `BodyNotEvaluable` by the depth bound's own reason, and a base-case-free recursion (`sum_eq`) declines the same way — never a hang, never a fabricated value; > **Phase 133 (2026-11-23, branch `feat/g4-133-uf-arm` from `feat/g4-132-named-supply` @ `0841dcf`) — THE Z3 UNINTERPRETED-FUNCTION ARM (D6a, G4_SCOPE §4): the G4 language build's last phase lands — a function-typed parameter binds as an uninterpreted function, application encodes as UF application, and `apply_twice` Verifies on congruence.** Code commits `5498db2` + `d3a1284`. **The mechanics:** `fresh_sym` binds a function-typed parameter as `Sym::Func { name, domain, range }` when its declared signature lies in the arm's slice; the declaration is carried **by name** (the pinned z3 crate's `FuncDecl` is not `Clone`) and rebuilt at each use — Z3 interns declarations by (name, domain, range), so every rebuild is the one symbol, the `int_to_str_uf` precedent — under the prefix `uf_param_<binding path>`, a name no spec or builtin can carry, so the Phase 100 refutation guard's by-name scan can never mistake a parameter's applications for the builtin's. Application engages at exactly two sites, `sym_call` (candidate bodies) and `encode_expr`'s Call arm (constraints, `require:` rows, forall bodies), under **the checker's own resolution order** (Phase 129): the index's specs resolve first, and the UF arm engages only where the index holds no spec of the callee's name and the environment binds that name to a UF — when it engages its outcome is final (an arity or sort mismatch declines, never falls through to inlining a namesake). `encodable.rs` mirrors exactly this slice (`Abs::Func`, `abs_apply`, the `fresh_abs` arm, the argument-sort discipline mirrored class for class), and the mirror-agreement battery pins the two predicates equal on six shapes in both directions. **The slice boundary, named:** domain and range sorts over the **Int family / Bool / String** — the sorts whose symbolic values are plain terms carrying no side conditions. **Char is out in both positions**: a UF-produced Char would owe a D5a range side condition no collector asserts (a countermodel could refute through a surrogate — the fabricated-countermodel class the F2 discipline exists to refuse), and a Char domain point is only as good as the side conditions its provenance happens to carry. List / Option / Result / Record / function ranges have no Z3 sort in this encoder; signatures mentioning any of them keep the standing **Opaque** binding and their applications stay unencodable. **The exit standing (§3): `apply_twice` Verified** — body encodable, the row `output == f(f(x))` a term equation Z3 discharges by congruence; the congruence content is stated at its true size by the companion pins (a single application against its own row Verifies by reflexivity through the UF; a `require:` row that states the point, `f(x) == x + 1`, makes the same body Verify against `output == x + 1` — the fact comes from the spec's own statement, not from the arm). **The boundary, pinned:** a point-value row (`output == f(0)` against a body applying at `x`) is **genuinely refuted, never Verified** — it is false for real functions and the arm does not rescue it; the list-ranged and Char specimens stay Inconclusive + unencodable; a Map body applying the parameter stays unencodable (§4's exclusion — the node encodings are §3.9's, not approximated here). **Refutation standing, decided and recorded:** a parameter is **universally quantified** — the spec claims its rows for every function — so a UF countermodel's finite point graph is a real function and a Sat through this arm is a genuine refutation: the once-applying body against `apply_twice`'s row is **VerificationFailed** with a concrete counterexample (x = 0). This is the exact opposite of the `int_to_str` UF (Phase 100), which stands for ONE specific function whose models need not be the real conversion — its guarded check (`int_to_str_apps` + `check_and_eval_ints_uf_guarded`) is untouched, and a row mentioning both UFs is still scanned and guarded on the `int_to_str` applications. **The two guards hold:** `ignore_f` still **Verifies** (an unused parameter's UF binding is inert — nothing in the encoding touches it); `same_f` stays **Inconclusive** — function equality is not UF reasoning: `sym_binop` has no Func arm, so `f == g` declines rather than encoding as declaration equality (which Z3 could have proven or refuted by symbol identity), and a body performing the comparison is unencodable. Two conservative declines recorded with the arm: a function **scrutinee** declines pattern conditions as `Undecidable` on both sides (not the `Never` the disjoint-sort arm would have claimed — the arm trades in no fact about the value beyond application), and statement-mode merges of function values decline (`stmt_sym_identical` is false for Func pairs) while `stmt_havoc` freshens a function variable to a fresh UF of the same signature under the havoc path's own name. The function **value flows through inlining**: a callee whose parameter is bound to the caller's UF applies the same symbol, and the composed specimen Verifies end to end. **Verdict drift — zero outside the named exhibits, measured:** the sweep instrument (every spec in the standing corpus — examples, self-host, stdlib, playground, held_out — verified against its `SpecIndex::callee_body` denotation under its module index; 195 specs) produces a **byte-identical before/after table**: 166 Verified, 25 NO_BODY (no denotation in the module index — the stdlib hand bodies among them are crowned through the pipeline's prelude-merged index, pinned by the stdlib suites, not this sweep), 3 Inconclusive (`smallest`, `sorted_probe`, `total_or_empty`), 1 VerificationFailed (`chained_fallback`) — the pinned table is asserted in `tests/phase133_uf_arm.rs` (its no-Z3 shape pinned on the same instrument: 195 / 25 / all-Inconclusive). Movement is confined to the frozen §3 probe exhibits, each measured on both trees (parent verdicts via a stash run on this tree): **`apply_twice` Inconclusive → Verified** (the exit standing); **`apply_req` Inconclusive → Verified** — its `require:` row `f(x) > 0` was unencodable, so Phase 109's discipline declined the whole verification; the row now encodes and is assumed, and the postcondition `output == x` is an identity — the UF content sits only in the assumed row, the proof uses no function fact; **`apply_fa` Inconclusive → Verified** — the faithful body now encodes and the forall row (Phase 94's envelope, binder unused) closes by reflexivity over the UF terms. Neither exhibit's verdict was frozen (§3 froze their check outcomes at Phase 129), §4's letter carries no row-kind carve-out, and both verdicts are the semantically correct ones; `pass_f` and `apply_atom` are unmoved (Predicate form — §3.10's), as are `sort`/`binary_search` (their comparators are generic-typed — outside the slice — atop their §3.9/§3.10 walls). The CONSTRAINT side sources the same requires PLUS each row's own antecedent: `encode_constraint`'s Implies arm encodes the consequent with the antecedent term added to the guard set (nested antecedents accumulate). The Forall arm CLEARS the set at the binder: bound consts are name-interned, so a same-named parameter's hypotheses would otherwise be terms over the bound variable and could discharge a read no execution guards — inside a quantifier, W2 guards come from the body's own antecedents; the binder's range guard is W3's arm (§2.7). `precondition_assumptions` keeps encoding the requires guard-free (they are the source, not a consumer: a require whose own read is unguarded declines the whole verification, as before). **The equality arm:** Eq/Neq over two pairs — and pair vs concrete list through the §2.5 bridge — encodes via `sym_list_eq` in the frozen §2.4 form, `len`-eq ∧ `∀ i. 0 ≤ i < len → select-eq`, the quantifier pattern-free on the Phase 94 precedent; **never raw array equality** (R1). Neq is the negation, no separate form. Pair-vs-`ListLen` equality has no arm (different element sorts) and declines. **Concat, §2.6's named answer made literal:** Concat of two pairs declines elementwise and binds as `Sym::ListLen(len_a + len_b)` — the length-only binding IS the decline-with-exact-length: length rows over a concatenation stand (pinned Verified, with teeth), every element row over the result declines through the `ListLen` consumers. **The probe pair (§4.1), W2's exit standing, pinned failing-first** (`tests/phase140_index_equality.rs`, 13 tests): **`oob_read` does not Verify** — the non-rescue evidence is threefold: the read declines in BOTH encodability predicates under its own spec (the guard it needs, `len(xs) < len(xs)`, is unsatisfiable, so no hypothesis set discharges it); it declines again under `last_read`'s guarded spec (the guard set is exact, never widened); and judged against a constant body the verdict is Inconclusive, not Refuted — the row was not totalized into something refutable either. **`last_read` Verifies** (the same read at `len(xs) − 1` under `require: len(xs) ≥ 1`), with teeth: the first-element body against its row is genuinely Refuted, and the identical spec minus its require falls to Inconclusive — the guard, not the read's shape, is what W2 added. The equality rows of `list_take`/`list_drop` (their `implies output == xs` shapes, distilled) encode and Verify at W2; the entries' full standings wait for W3's quantifiers. **The mirror, shape for shape:** `Abs::ArrayLen` carries `AbsLen` — `Known(n)` (a crossed literal's count), `Param(name, off)` (a directly-bound parameter's length term plus an append offset; set only in `param_env`), `Unknown` (nested pairs, unlike merges) — and the discharge is **difference logic** over bases extracted from the require rows' atomic conjuncts: sound over the integers, and a stated subset of the solver's entailment (the mirror declines where the domain cannot state the fact — nested-pair lengths, non-linear facts, Let-bound index forms — never the reverse). Because the real guards are terms, the mirror disciplines names instead: a parameter's `Var` form dies when a Let/Match binding shadows it and inside inlined callees, while length forms ride on the values themselves. The formula is built with that domain as the binder's guard (antecedent for `forall`, conjunct for `exists`) and the body is encoded with the domain conjuncts as its guard set — §2.3's doctrine mechanized: a `select` is produced only where its in-range condition is a conjunct/antecedent of the very formula, so beyond-length content can never decide a row in either direction. On every corpus row the derived domain coincides with the textual `range(...)` domain under the check's facts (verified per entry below); where W2's arm already encoded a body (its own antecedents entailed each read's in-range fact) the added antecedent is a logical no-op, so no standing verdict's claim changes. Bodies with no binder-indexed paired read keep the **bare Phase 94 form byte-for-byte** (self-guarding rows, pure-Int rows, the tokenizer rows, gcd's row — no index reads over paired lists ⇒ no domain ⇒ unbounded, exactly as recorded). The exists arm is the exact dual (domain as conjunct; the P137 exists shape Verifies with teeth — the constant-false body Refutes). **Length well-formedness, the phase's third discovery:** a probe showed symbolic lengths are sign-free Int consts — the row `len(xs) >= 0` was **VerificationFailed** for the `len` body (countermodel len = −1) — and without a fix even `list_reverse`'s unconditional `len(output) == len(xs)` row is unprovable (negative-length worlds refute it). The end expression is re-evaluated per iteration, as the While form denotes; corpus ends are pure, where the readings coincide. The loop's invariant is **stated data**: `shipped_loop_invariant(name)` in `src/stdlib.rs`, authored beside `shipped_body` as prefix forms of each entry's own postconditions, consulted ONLY by `verify_one` (keyed by spec name, exactly as the engine reaches `shipped_body`) and threaded via `StmtCtx::for_invariant` (root and child both None — the supply names the spec whose OWN body is under judgment). Both halves of §2.5 landed: `stmt_havoc`'s `Sym::List` arm splits by item sort (a concrete list of Int terms havocs to a fresh pair, its exact fresh form in the paired representation; any other sort keeps the length-only havoc — its element sort has no pair, R9; `Sym::ListLen` still havocs to ListLen, its element sort unknown from the Sym), and `cross_concrete_int_lists` crosses the entry environment for the initiation encoding only. **THE EIGHT CROWNED** (each: `Verifier::with_specs(prelude)` + shipped body, every postcondition row Proven, battery via `eval::run_spec_tests` — Verified ∧ battery-exact, the Tier-1 shape; labels move at Phase 144): `list_reverse` Verified, battery 6/6 · `list_contains` Verified, 7/7 · `list_min` Verified, 6/6 · `list_max` Verified, 6/6 · `list_take` Verified, 7/7 · `list_drop` Verified, 7/7 · `list_is_sorted` Verified, 9/9 · `range` Verified, 7/7. > **Phase 142 (2026-11-24, branch `feat/encoder-142-fold-form` from `feat/encoder-141-quantifiers` @ `04aab4a`) — W4 LANDED: the fold-form arm, and THE THREE CROWNED — the §3.2 W4-insufficiency rule (R4) does NOT trigger: the arm discharges all three frozen rows honestly under exactly §2.8's prefix definition, so `list_sum`, `list_product` and `list_fold` stand Verified ∧ battery-exact (Tier labels move at Phase 144's re-tier, not here).** Code commit `453c89b`. **The arm as built** (all in `src/verify/verifier.rs`, the fold section above `encode_expr`): a `"fold"` arm in `encode_expr`'s Call match, before the `sym_invoke` fallback. A fold over a paired `List<Int>` binding is the op's fold function applied to `(elems, len, init)`; a fold over a concrete list is the prefix definition evaluated outright (no function, no characterization owed — the value is determined); a fold over `ListLen`, a non-Int list, or a non-Int initial value declines. **The prefix form:** `fold(list_take(xs, i), init, op)` — §2.8's own subject, the fold over the consumed prefix — is denoted directly as the fold term at the **clamped count** `ite(i ≤ 0, 0, ite(i ≥ len, len, i))`, exact for every `i` by `list_take`'s frozen contract (its pair is the base pair at the clamped length; beyond-length content is unobservable to the fold, whose definition selects only below the length argument), so no guard is owed — no index term is produced. The interception is name-keyed on the standing builtin precedent (`len`, `int_to_str` in the same match): a caller spec of its own named `list_take` is read by the prefix rule inside a fold, exactly as a caller-named `len` is read by the length arm; a bare `list_take(...)` outside a fold encodes exactly as it did. **The op slice** is the contracts' own shapes: a **closed lambda** whose body is Int arithmetic over its two parameters — its identity is the canonical rendering of the body with the parameters replaced positionally (`#0`/`#1`), FNV-1a-hashed into the function name, so alpha-renamed writings of the same op (the contract's `|acc, v|`, an invariant's) name the same function and structurally different ops (`a + v` against `v + a`) name different ones, §2.8 asserting nothing across ops; and the **function-typed parameter itself** at signature (Int, Int) → Int (`list_fold`'s `f`, a UF under the Phase 133 arm), its step branch stated over UF applications — congruence only, §2.9's Fold point. A capturing lambda, a UF of another signature, or a lambda body outside the arithmetic slice declines, and its fold rows decline with it (pinned). **The realization — the phase's central measurement.** §2.8 names two: the rows as axioms over an uninterpreted fold function, or structural recursion on the length. **The axiom form was built first and measured**: base + step as universally quantified axioms over the array (step in its n-form, pattern on the fold application), threaded through both row judges and the statement route's assumptions. It **discharges every proof** — all three crowns Verify under it — but every session carrying the axioms answers **Unknown in the refutation direction**: a ground row (`output == fold([1, 2, 3], …)` against an off-by-one body) fails model validation in ~6 ms, and symbolic refutations (a constant body against each of the three contracts) burn the full 5 s per-constraint budget in the instantiation cascade — with and without explicit patterns, identically. Under the axiom form the crowns would stand with **no refutation teeth at all**, and a crown whose wrong bodies cannot Refute is not the measurement the freeze prescribes — so the axiom build was withdrawn and the **structural-recursion realization** taken: one Z3 **recursive function definition** per op, `F(a, n, init) = ite(n ≤ 0, init, op(F(a, n − 1, init), select(a, n − 1)))`, whose two branches are exactly the frozen rows (base at the empty prefix; step at n = k + 1 applying the op once to the fold of the prefix of length k and the element at k). The `n ≤ 0` guard is the base row; counts below zero are outside the fold's domain (a prefix has count ≥ 0 and every session judging a fold row asserts length well-formedness) — that branch is the definition's totality at a point no execution and no battery reaches, never a fact a verdict rests on: at every count ≥ 0 the definition is the prefix definition and nothing else — no closed form, no commutativity or associativity, nothing about reordered or filtered folds. Registered once in the Z3 context, the definition is present in every session (row judges, invariant obligations, the exhaustion gate) with **no quantified axiom asserted anywhere**, and both directions decide in milliseconds. **One Z3 trap the build stepped in and mapped:** `RecFuncDecl::new` on an already-defined name does **not** intern the way `FuncDecl::new` does — a second declaration object for the same name shadows the definition and its applications go opaque (measured raw: the same assertions are Sat through the original declaration object, Unsat through a fresh one; in the verifier the symptom was order-dependent — the first fold spec judged on a thread behaved, later ones false-Verified against constant bodies, caught by the teeth before anything rested on it). The declaration object is therefore created exactly once per op, with its definition, and cached (`FOLD_DECLS`, thread-local, the context's own lifetime). **The vehicle** is Phase 141's stated-invariant machinery, unamended: `shipped_loop_invariant` gains the three prefix-form texts (`0 <= i; len(xs) >= 0 implies i <= len(xs); acc == fold(list_take(xs, i), init, op)` — sum at `0`/`+`, product at `1`/`*`, fold at `init`/`f`), discharged by the standing Phase 96 obligations — initiation IS the base row (at `i = 0` the clamp is 0 and the accumulator is the initial value), consecution IS the step row at the counter (the body step applies the op once to the accumulator and the guarded `select` at `i`), exit is the counter at the length, where the clamped prefix is the whole list and the invariant's fold is the postcondition's own term. **One precision fix rides the invariant route's scope check only:** a binder-aware sibling pair (`expr_free_vars_scoped` / `constraint_free_vars_scoped`) — the standing `expr_free_vars` deliberately over-approximates (a lambda's parameters count as free) and its other consumers are written against that shape (the statement-call capture guard declines on it; the W3 domain derivation follows it), but the scope check asks which names the invariant *reads* from the loop state, and a fold op's parameters are bound by the lambda itself — before W4 no stated invariant carried a lambda, so the distinction never arose. The scoped pair subtracts lambda/comprehension binders (as `constraint_free_vars` already subtracts quantifier binders) and is used at that one site; the standing pair is byte-untouched. **THE THREE CROWNED** (each: `Verifier::with_specs(prelude)` + shipped body, the fold row Proven, battery via `eval::run_spec_tests`): `list_sum` Verified, battery 8/8 · `list_product` Verified, 8/8 · `list_fold` Verified, 6/6 — `list_fold` under the joint rule exactly as §3.3 carries it (its fold half is this arm; the composition it needed is §2.9's Fold point, carried by the definition's UF step branch). **Crown teeth** (`tests/phase142_fold_form.rs`, 6 tests, written failing-first): the shipped sum loop returning `acc + 1` **Refutes** (the loop closes under the invariant, then the row decides: at the empty list the body says 1, the fold says 0); a constant body **Refutes** against `list_sum` and against `list_fold` (the UF's value at one step is a genuine countermodel — the parameter ranges over every function); the wrong-init sum loop, the adding-step product body, and the swapped-argument fold body each fall **Inconclusive** through the failed invariant (initiation resp. consecution does not discharge) — never a Verified bought by an invariant the body does not keep. **Row specimens:** a concrete fold Verifies exactly and Refutes off-by-one; the take-prefix row Refutes a constant body in range and **Verifies it at `i ≤ 0`** — the clamp is the denotation, not a raw count (a raw-count term would leave the negative fold unconstrained and stand Inconclusive); §2.8's limit is pinned — the same sum claimed under **both** op argument orders stays Inconclusive (their equality at a symbolic length is an induction the prefix definition does not assert). **The mirror:** NO change to `src/verify/encodable.rs` — W4's acceptance is row-side (constraint rows and invariant rows), where the mirror's standing boundary is silence; it judges bodies. The phase file's battery pins agreement as declines on both sides for every fold body shape (the `Fold` node, a `fold(...)` call body, the three shipped bodies) and the fold-require shapes (a fold require contributes no in-range fact on either side; beside the range requires, a guarded read encodes on both — the fold row itself now encodes on the real side, and as a guard term it is inert: it constrains no index). **No body-side fold arm was built, deliberately:** the shipped bodies are For loops, and a `sym_call` fold arm would flip `list_fold`'s sweep denotation (a `Call("fold", …)` body) to Verified by reflexivity — body term ≡ row term — whether or not its shipped body proved; the crown must be the shipped body's, so the denotation keeps declining and the sweep stays honest. **Drift discipline:** the Phase 133 sweep is **byte-identical** (201 specs — 166 Verified / 30 NO_BODY / 4 Inconclusive {`list_fold`, `smallest`, `sorted_probe`, `total_or_empty`} / 1 VerificationFailed — `list_fold`'s sweep verdict stands Inconclusive by the paragraph above; its crown shows on the prelude route); the eight crowned at 141 stand Verified; the HO four, `list_binary_search` and `list_sort` stand Inconclusive; the `oob_read`/`last_read` probe pair holds its standings; the Phase 115 pipeline-crown pin (`the_pipeline_crowns_no_verified_tier2_body`) is unmoved — the seeded pipeline's winners are unchanged samples, and the crown is the shipped body's through the production verifier, as at W3. **R10 retirements, in place with their stories:** Phase 141's nine-pin becomes `phase141_the_six_stand_inconclusive` (the three retire, the six stand); the Phase 137 standings pin gains `CROWNED_AT_W4`; the Phase 115 pin renames to `tier2_verdicts_the_section_3_9_standing_after_w4` (nine of its eleven crowned, two standing); the Phase 135 pin renames to `phase135_verdicts_the_tier2_standing_after_w4` (`range` at W3, `list_fold` at W4, the four HO entries standing). (b) **Beyond congruence stands not Verified**: a value-at-a-point row over elements (the body the direct read, the row `output == f(xs[0])`) is **VerificationFailed** — a countermodel function (constant 0 over `[5]`) genuinely refutes it, exactly the Phase 133 point-value shape carried over element terms; an injectivity row over elements (`f(xs[0]) == f(xs[1])` implies `xs[0] == xs[1]`) is **VerificationFailed** the same way (a constant function over a two-element list); and an application at an **unguarded** index (`f(xs[len(xs)])`) declines with its row — unencodable on both sides of the mirror, Inconclusive: the UF is never applied to a term no execution could produce. **Crown teeth:** the identity-append map body and the swapped-step all/any bodies fall **Inconclusive** through the failed invariant (the stated characterization is attempted — the supply is name-keyed — and consecution does not discharge: congruence equates nothing for them); the unconditional-append and inverted-predicate filter bodies fall Inconclusive the same way; `list_map` returning its input **Refutes** (the pointwise row separates `xs[i]` from `f(xs[i])` under a countermodel function), `list_map` returning `[]` Refutes on the length row, and the constant bodies against `list_all`/`list_any` Refute on their counterexample/witness rows. **R6 measured in both directions:** a filter body keeping **at most the first element, only when it passes**, satisfies both frozen rows exactly while dropping passing elements the name's gloss promises — it **Verifies**: Tier-1 certifies the frozen contract, measurably, not the gloss (the re-tier surfaces carry the rows, §3.3's honesty clause). > **Phase 154 (2026-11-25, branch `feat/disebar-154-verb` from `feat/disebar-153-freeze-edge` @ `97f4165`) — THE USER-PACKAGE VERB LANDED: `morphic build --package-from <file.morph>` builds §4 of the freeze (code `f37981d`, ahead of this note).** **The verb:** for each spec of the user's module, one seeded bounded LLM-free run (seed default 42) through a new API entry point, `api::synthesize_seeded_spec_winner`, which returns the report and the crowned body **from the same run** — so the packaged body is the body the rows describe, never a second run's body wearing the first run's measurements. The generator's inputs are built **only from that run's measured rows**: the verdict from the run's `verification_status`, the battery from its executed counts (pinned = the tests the crown passed; spec-silent = the run's per-test `spec_silent` outcomes). **Admission, as frozen:** Verified with an exact battery on its evaluable points (passed == evaluable — the assembly's own Tier-1 judgment) → tier-1 / `z3-verified`; executed-exact (passed == evaluable == total, total > 0 — the standing Tier-2 strictness, no spec-silent points at this tier) → tier-2 / `executed-exact`; anything else refused by name. **The refusal reading, recorded:** the freeze's "refused by name, and nothing is written" is taken in its stricter sense — if ANY spec is refused, the whole assembly is refused and no file set exists (the looser reading would let a module's package silently omit the spec that failed). The stdlib crown checks do not transfer, as frozen; the refusal discipline, the generator, and the layout shell do — the shell is generalized in place (`PackageFurniture`: description / license / license files / project links), and the stdlib assembly through it is **byte-identical** (Phase 122's checked-in-package pin stands green, unmeasured drift zero). `generate_bindings_versioned` splits the manifest's two version facts: a user package's `packageVersion` is the author's (flag), its `morphicVersion` stays the generating pipeline's own. **Surface:** flags `--package-from`, `--package-name` (default: the module file's stem), `--package-version` (default: the Morphic version), `--seed` (default 42), `--out` (default: `<stem>-package`); no flag supplies a tier, a verdict basis, or a battery figure — the flag surface is pinned by name against the claim-shaped absences. The user package's `package.json` asserts no license and no project links on the author's behalf; its generated README carries the measured-rows provenance language (the seed named; re-running the verb byte-for-byte is the package's re-judgment route) and EMBED_SCOPE §3's `never` stance for function-typed parameters. > **Phase 155 (2026-11-25, branch `feat/disebar-155-lsp` from `feat/disebar-154-verb` @ `9e38c8c`) — THE LSP DIAGNOSTICS-ONLY SERVER LANDED: `morphic lsp` is the real server §5 froze (code `70c2a65`, ahead of this note).** **The server (`src/lsp.rs`, zero new dependencies):** hand-rolled JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio framed the LSP way — `Content-Length` headers + exactly N bytes, header names case-insensitive, Content-Type ignored — the framing the MCP core measurably lacked. What transfers from that core is its dispatch pattern and error vocabulary (−32700 / −32600 / −32601 naming the method); its notification discipline is **inverted**, as frozen: LSP's `didOpen` / `didChange` / `didClose` are id-less and **execute** (they carry the document state), and `publishDiagnostics` is itself an id-less server→client notification. Unknown requests decline −32601 by name; unknown notifications are ignored per protocol; no input panics the server — a garbage-JSON body and a header block with an unusable Content-Length are each answered −32700 and reading resumes at the next frame, pinned at the binary. **Surface and lifecycle (§5.2):** `initialize` answers exactly one capability group — `textDocumentSync {openClose: true, change: 1}` (full-document sync, D5a) — plus serverInfo; `initialized` is unanswered; every open/change re-checks the whole text through `api::check` and publishes; `didClose` publishes the clear; `shutdown` answers null; the process exit code is the lifecycle's own (0 after shutdown, 1 without — EOF alike). Document state is a URI→text map. **Diagnostics (§5.3, D3a/R3):** at most ONE per check — `api::check`'s error is singular, stated in the module header as the engine's measured shape, not an apology. A parse error publishes at its true position (the API's 1-based line/column converted mechanically to 0-based; the transcript's fixture measures (6,5) → (5,4)); a typecheck error publishes as ONE file-level diagnostic at (0,0)–(0,0), severity Error, source `morphic`, whose message is the verbatim typecheck message — spec name and all — prefixed `unpositioned: `; a clean file publishes an empty set. Diagnostics-only means diagnostics-only: no other capability is claimed on the wire (the capabilities object's size is itself pinned). **The stub's fate (D4a):** the banner-printing arm is replaced; the banner is suppressed for this subcommand on the standing machine-surface precedent, and the transcript asserts the stream's first bytes are a `Content-Length` header. ## 🚫 ANTI-PATTERNS (JANGAN DILAKUKAN)

| ❌ Anti-pattern | ✅ Correct approach |
|---|---|
| Langsung sintesis komponen besar (parser 1000+ lines) | Decompose jadi sub-fungsi ≤200 lines |
| Percaya hasil Z3 tanpa cross-validation | Selalu cross-validate dengan compiler original |
| Hapus kode Rust asli setelah generated code masuk | Keep both, gunakan feature flag untuk switch |
| Satu branch untuk semua komponen | Satu branch per komponen, merge bertahap |
| Skip benchmark karena "masih prototype" | Benchmark setiap komponen, tetapkan baseline |
| Gunakan generated compiler untuk generate compiler lain | Gunakan Rust compiler original sebagai bootstrap |
| Spesifikasi terlalu longgar → hasil synthesis valid tapi salah | Spesifikasi ketat dengan golden test suite |

The new body is a bubble sort from the proven scan vocabulary: `Alloc` a working list bound to the moved `list` parameter, nested `For` loops over `0..len` / `1..len`, an `If` on a DIRECT fn-pointer call `cmp(clone(a[j]), clone(a[j-1]))` (element reads are clone-mediated `UnaryOp::Clone` on Index places), and a swap of `Let tmp` + two `Assign`s on Index places; locals are collision-safe (`fresh_name`). Both emitters produce it identically, so it is the shared rendering of that body shape, kin to the Phase 25/29 E0369 Concat-ownership family but distinct from it: the operand is a compound expression (an inlined Match), not a literal or a Var, so no ownership treatment fires.
